title_en: Small Generalizable Prompt Predictive Models Can Steer Efficient RL Post-Training of Large Reasoning Models
title_zh: 小规模可泛化提示预测模型可引导大型推理模型的高效RL后训练

sentences.en: Reinforcement learning enhances the reasoning capabilities of large language models but often involves high computational costs due to rollout-intensive optimization.
sentences.zh: 强化学习增强了大型语言模型的推理能力，但由于需要密集rollout的优化，往往带来高昂的计算成本。

sentences.en: Online prompt selection presents a plausible solution by prioritizing informative prompts to improve training efficiency.
sentences.zh: 在线提示选择通过优先选择信息量大的提示来提升训练效率，是一种合理的解决方案。

sentences.en: However, current methods either depend on costly, exact evaluations or construct prompt-specific predictive models lacking generalization across prompts.
sentences.zh: 然而，当前方法要么依赖代价高昂的精确评估，要么构建缺乏跨提示泛化能力的提示特定预测模型。

sentences.en: This study introduces Generalizable Predictive Prompt Selection (GPS), which performs Bayesian inference towards prompt difficulty using a lightweight generative model trained on the shared optimization history.
sentences.zh: 本研究引入了可泛化预测提示选择（GPS），它使用在共享优化历史上训练的轻量级生成模型，对提示难度进行贝叶斯推断。

sentences.en: Intermediate-difficulty prioritization and history-anchored diversity are incorporated into the batch acquisition principle to select informative prompt batches.
sentences.zh: 在批次获取原则中融入了中等难度优先和历史锚定的多样性，以选择信息量大的提示批次。

sentences.en: The small predictive model also generalizes at test-time for efficient computational allocation.
sentences.zh: 这个小规模预测模型还能在测试时泛化，用于高效的计算分配。

sentences.en: Experiments across varied reasoning benchmarks indicate GPS's substantial improvements in training efficiency, final performance, and test-time efficiency over superior baseline methods.
sentences.zh: 在多种推理基准上的实验表明，相较于优越的基线方法，GPS在训练效率、最终性能和测试时效率上均有显著改进。

sentences.en: The code is available at https://github.com/thu-rllab/GPS.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/thu-rllab/GPS 获取。

title_en: Smaller Models are Natural Explorers for Policy-Level Diversity in GRPO
title_zh: 较小的模型是GRPO中策略级多样性的天然探索者

sentences.en: We identify a new dimension for enhancing rollout diversity in Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) for LLMs.
sentences.zh: 我们为LLM的组相对策略优化（GRPO）识别出增强rollout多样性的一个新维度。

sentences.en: While GRPO relies on diverse rollouts, prevailing strategies primarily increase diversity by injecting more token-level randomness, which may introduce step-wise noise and leads to incoherent trajectories.
sentences.zh: 虽然GRPO依赖多样化的rollout，但主流策略主要通过注入更多token级随机性来增加多样性，这可能引入逐步噪声并导致不连贯的轨迹。

sentences.en: We uncover that smaller models within the same model family inherently exhibit higher policy-level diversity, indicated by their superior pass@k relative to larger counterparts as sample counts increase.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，同一模型家族中较小的模型天然表现出更高的策略级多样性，表现在随着样本数增加，其pass@k优于较大的对应模型。

sentences.en: Unlike token-level noise, this diversity is temporally correlated, preserves logical consistency, and provides structured exploration signals for gradient estimation.
sentences.zh: 与token级噪声不同，这种多样性是时间相关的，保持了逻辑一致性，并为梯度估计提供了结构化的探索信号。

sentences.en: We thus propose S2L-PO (Small-to-Large Policy Optimization), a framework that leverages fixed small models as natural explorers to train larger models.
sentences.zh: 因此我们提出了S2L-PO（从小到大的策略优化），一个利用固定的小模型作为天然探索者来训练更大模型的框架。

sentences.en: To balance exploration and exploitation, we design a progressive annealing strategy that transitions from offline small-model rollouts to the large learner’s own sampling.
sentences.zh: 为平衡探索与利用，我们设计了一种渐进退火策略，从离线小模型rollout过渡到大学习器自身的采样。

sentences.en: This shift elegantly avoids mid-training performance drops caused by the small model's capacity limits, achieving faster convergence and unlocking a higher performance ceiling.
sentences.zh: 这种转变巧妙避免了因小模型容量限制导致的中期训练性能下降，实现了更快的收敛并解锁了更高的性能上限。

sentences.en: S2L-PO improves accuracy on diverse mathematical reasoning benchmarks (eg., +8.8\% on AIME 24 using a 1.7B explorer to guide the 8B model) while reducing rollout compute.
sentences.zh: S2L-PO在多种数学推理基准上提升了准确率（例如，使用1.7B探索者引导8B模型，在AIME 24上提升+8.8\%），同时减少了rollout计算量。

sentences.en: The code will be made available.
sentences.zh: 代码将予以公开。

title_en: SMART: Scalable Mesh‑free Aerodynamic Simulations from Raw Geometries using a Transformer‑based Surrogate Model
title_zh: SMART：使用基于Transformer的代理模型从原始几何进行可扩展无网格空气动力学仿真

sentences.en: Machine learning–based surrogate models have emerged as more efficient alternatives to numerical solvers for physical simulations over complex geometries, such as car bodies.
sentences.zh: 基于机器学习的代理模型已成为复杂几何（如车身）物理仿真的数值求解器的更高效替代方案。

sentences.en: Many existing models incorporate the simulation mesh as an additional input, thereby reducing prediction errors.
sentences.zh: 许多现有模型将仿真网格作为额外输入，从而降低了预测误差。

sentences.en: However, generating a simulation mesh for new geometries is computationally costly.
sentences.zh: 然而，为新几何体生成仿真网格的计算成本很高。

sentences.en: In contrast, mesh-free methods, which do not rely on the simulation mesh, typically incur higher errors.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，不依赖仿真网格的无网格方法通常会产生更高的误差。

sentences.en: Motivated by these considerations, we introduce SMART, a neural surrogate model that predicts physical quantities at arbitrary query locations using only a point-cloud representation of the geometry, without requiring access to the simulation mesh.
sentences.zh: 基于这些考虑，我们引入了SMART，一个神经代理模型，仅使用几何体的点云表示即可在任意查询位置预测物理量，而无需访问仿真网格。

sentences.en: The geometry and simulation parameters are encoded into a shared latent space that captures both structural and parametric characteristics of the physical field.
sentences.zh: 几何和仿真参数被编码到一个共享的潜在空间中，该空间捕捉物理场的结构和参数化特征。

sentences.en: A physics decoder then attends to the encoder's intermediate latent representations to map spatial queries to physical quantities.
sentences.zh: 然后，一个物理解码器关注编码器的中间潜在表示，将空间查询映射到物理量。

sentences.en: Through this cross-layer interaction, the model jointly updates latent geometric features and the evolving physical field.
sentences.zh: 通过这种跨层交互，模型联合更新潜在几何特征和不断演化的物理场。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments show that SMART is competitive with and often outperforms existing methods that rely on the simulation mesh as input, demonstrating its capabilities for industry-level simulations.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，SMART与依赖仿真网格作为输入的现有方法具有竞争力，且往往更优，展示了其用于工业级仿真的能力。

title_en: SmartThinker: Progressive Chain-of-Thought Length Calibration for Efficient Large Language Model Reasoning
title_zh: SmartThinker：用于高效大语言模型推理的渐进式思维链长度校准

sentences.en: Large reasoning models (LRMs) like OpenAI o1 and DeepSeek-R1 achieve high accuracy on complex tasks by adopting long chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning paths.
sentences.zh: 像OpenAI o1和DeepSeek-R1这样的大型推理模型（LRM）通过采用长的思维链（CoT）推理路径，在复杂任务上取得了高准确率。

sentences.en: However, the inherent verbosity of these processes frequently results in redundancy and overthinking.
sentences.zh: 然而，这些过程固有的冗长性常常导致冗余和过度思考。

sentences.en: To address this issue, existing works leverage Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to reduce LRM output length, but their static length-reward designs fail to adapt to problem difficulty and response-length distributions, causing over-compression and compromised accuracy.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，现有工作利用组相对策略优化（GRPO）来减少LRM输出长度，但其静态的长度奖励设计无法适应问题难度和答案长度分布，导致过度压缩和准确率受损。

sentences.en: Therefore, we propose *SmartThinker*, a novel GRPO-based efficient reasoning method with progressive CoT length calibration.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们提出了*SmartThinker*，一种基于GRPO的新颖高效推理方法，采用渐进式CoT长度校准。

sentences.en: *SmartThinker* makes a two-fold contribution:  First, it dynamically estimates the optimal length with peak accuracy during training and guides overlong responses toward it to reduce reasoning length while sustaining accuracy.
sentences.zh: *SmartThinker*有两方面的贡献：首先，它在训练期间动态估计达到峰值准确率的最优长度，并引导过长的回答朝该长度靠拢，以在维持准确率的同时减少推理长度。

sentences.en: Second, it dynamically modulates the length-reward coefficient to avoid the unwarranted penalization of correct reasoning paths.
sentences.zh: 其次，它动态调节长度奖励系数，以避免对正确推理路径进行不当惩罚。

sentences.en: Extensive experimental results show that *SmartThinker* achieves up to 52.6\% length compression with improved accuracy and achieves up to 16.6\% accuracy relative improvement on challenging benchmarks like AIME25.
sentences.zh: 大量实验结果表明，*SmartThinker*实现了高达52.6\%的长度压缩并提升了准确率，在AIME25等具有挑战性的基准上实现了最高16.6\%的相对准确率提升。

sentences.en: The source code can be found at https://github.com/SJTU-RTEAS/SmartThinker.
sentences.zh: 源代码可在 https://github.com/SJTU-RTEAS/SmartThinker 获取。

title_en: SMD: Multi-view Safety-Critical Driving Video Generation in the Real-world Domain
title_zh: SMD：真实世界域中的多视角安全关键驾驶视频生成

sentences.en: Safety-critical scenarios are essential for evaluating autonomous driving (AD) systems, yet they are rare in practice.
sentences.zh: 安全关键场景对于评估自动驾驶（AD）系统至关重要，但在实际中却十分罕见。

sentences.en: Existing generators produce trajectories, simulations, or single-view videos—but they donot meet what modern AD systems actually consume: realistic multi-view video.
sentences.zh: 现有的生成器能产生轨迹、仿真或单视角视频——但它们无法满足现代 AD 系统实际消费的输入：真实的多视角视频。

sentences.en: We present SMD, the first framework for generating multi-view safety-critical driving videos in the real-world domain.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 SMD，这是首个在真实世界域中生成多视角安全关键驾驶视频的框架。

sentences.en: SMD couples a safety-critical trajectory engine with a diffusion-based multi-view video generator through three design choices.
sentences.zh: SMD 通过三个设计选择，将安全关键轨迹引擎与基于扩散的多视角视频生成器相结合。

sentences.en: First, we pick the right adversary: a GRPO-fine-tuned vision-language model (VLM) that understands multi-camera context and selects vehicles most likely to induce hazards.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们选取正确的对抗者：一个经过 GRPO 微调的视觉语言模型（VLM），它能够理解多摄像头上下文，并选择最有可能引发危险的车辆。

sentences.en: Second, we generate the right motion: a two-stage trajectory process that (i) produces collisions, then (ii) transforms them into natural evasion trajectories—preserving risk while staying within what current video generators can faithfully render.
sentences.zh: 其次，我们生成正确的运动：一个两阶段轨迹过程，先（i）产生碰撞，再（ii）将其转化为自然的避让轨迹——既保留风险，又保持在当前视频生成器能够忠实渲染的范围内。

sentences.en: Third, we synthesize the right data: a diffusion model that turns these trajectories into multi-view videos suitable for end-to-end planners.
sentences.zh: 第三，我们合成正确的数据：一个扩散模型，将这些轨迹转化为适用于端到端规划器的多视角视频。

sentences.en: Videos generated by SMD substantially increase collision rates when stress testing multiple end-to-end planners, and reduce collision rates when incorporated into training, improving planner robustness and safety.
sentences.zh: 在对多个端到端规划器进行压力测试时，SMD 生成的视频能显著提高碰撞率；而将其纳入训练后，又能降低碰撞率，从而提升规划器的鲁棒性和安全性。

sentences.en: Our code and video examples are available at: \href{https://icml-2.github.io/SMD/}{https://icml-2.github.io/SMD/}.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码和视频示例可在以下网址获取：\href{https://icml-2.github.io/SMD/}{https://icml-2.github.io/SMD/}。

title_en: SMILE: Extended Deep Submodular Function-Based Instruction and In-context Learning Demonstration Selection
title_zh: SMILE：基于扩展深度子模函数的指令与上下文学习演示选择

sentences.en: Prompt optimization is a key way to steer large language models when fine-tuning is impractical.
sentences.zh: 当微调不可行时，提示优化是引导大语言模型的关键方式。

sentences.en: However, instruction optimization (IO) and in-context learning (ICL) demonstration selection are often optimized separately and combined post hoc, implicitly assuming that a "best'' instruction and a "best" demonstration set compose well.
sentences.zh: 然而，指令优化（IO）和上下文学习（ICL）演示选择往往被分别优化、事后组合，隐式假设“最佳”指令与“最佳”演示集能够良好组合。

sentences.en: In practice, their interactions are strong, making such decoupled pipelines brittle.
sentences.zh: 在实际中，它们的相互作用很强，使得这种解耦式流程往往很脆弱。

sentences.en: We propose SMILE, an efficient method that *jointly* selects instructions and demonstrations.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 SMILE，一种*联合*选择指令和演示的高效方法。

sentences.en: Our key observation is that the ICL performance exhibits consistent diminishing returns across diverse instructions.
sentences.zh: 我们的关键观察是：ICL 的性能在不同指令下始终表现出一致的收益递减规律。

sentences.en: Leveraging this structure, SMILE learns an instruction-conditioned surrogate aligned with LLM feedback and instantiates it as an Extended Deep Submodular Function that captures sample--sample coverage, sample--query relevance, and sample--instruction compatibility.
sentences.zh: 利用这一结构，SMILE 学习一个与 LLM 反馈对齐的、以指令为条件的代理模型，并将其实例化为一个扩展深度子模函数，该函数捕获样本--样本覆盖度、样本--查询相关性以及样本--指令兼容性。

sentences.en: SMILE then performs greedy, query-adaptive selection of the instruction--demonstration pair.
sentences.zh: 随后，SMILE 对指令--演示对执行贪心式、随查询自适应的选择。

sentences.en: Experiments on six datasets and multiple LLM backbones show that SMILE consistently outperforms IO-only, ICL-only, and existing joint baselines, supporting a context engineering view of prompting: jointly optimizing interacting components rather than tuning them in isolation.
sentences.zh: 在六个数据集和多种 LLM 主干上的实验表明，SMILE 持续优于仅用 IO、仅用 ICL 以及现有的联合基线，从而支持了提示的上下文工程视角：联合优化相互作用的组件，而非孤立地逐一调优。

title_en: SMM Transformer: Leveraging Spiking Neural Networks for Multimodal Tasks
title_zh: SMM Transformer：利用脉冲神经网络处理多模态任务

sentences.en: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) enable event-driven computation with sparse activations, but building multimodal Transformers on SNNs is hindered by unstable training in deep spiking stacks and a mismatch between dense softmax attention and spike-based communication.
sentences.zh: 脉冲神经网络（SNN）凭借稀疏激活实现了事件驱动计算，但基于 SNN 构建多模态 Transformer 仍受两大因素阻碍：深层脉冲堆叠中的训练不稳定，以及密集 softmax 注意力与基于脉冲的通信之间的不匹配。

sentences.en: We propose SMM Transformer, an SNN-based multimodal Transformer framework that combines (i) a Parallel LIF with Multistage Learnable Parameters (PLMP) neuron and a tailored P-STBP algorithm to stabilize training, (ii) a spike-driven attention approximation (SMSA) with a lightweight self-compensation branch, and (iii) a spiking mixture-of-experts (SMoE) module for modality-aware fusion.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 SMM Transformer，一个基于 SNN 的多模态 Transformer 框架，它结合了：(i) 一种带多阶段可学习参数（PLMP）的并行 LIF 神经元与专门定制的 P-STBP 算法来稳定训练；(ii) 一个带轻量级自补偿分支的脉冲驱动注意力近似（SMSA）；以及 (iii) 一个用于模态感知融合的脉冲混合专家（SMoE）模块。

sentences.en: Across visual and multimodal benchmarks, SMM Transformer achieves competitive accuracy compared to ANN baselines while reducing the estimated compute energy of the attention module by up to 97\% under a standard MAC/AC cost model.
sentences.zh: 在视觉和多模态基准上，与 ANN 基线相比，SMM Transformer 在取得有竞争力的精度的同时，还将注意力模块的估计计算能耗最多降低 97\%，其依据是标准的 MAC/AC 成本模型。

title_en: Smooth Dynamic Cutoffs for Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials
title_zh: 机器学习原子间势的平滑动态截断

sentences.en: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) have proven to be wildly useful for molecular dynamics simulations, powering countless drug and materials discovery applications.
sentences.zh: 机器学习原子间势（MLIP）已被证明对分子动力学模拟极为有用，驱动着无数药物与材料发现应用。

sentences.en: However, MLIPs face two primary bottlenecks preventing them from reaching realistic simulation scales: inference time and memory consumption.
sentences.zh: 然而，MLIP 面临两大主要瓶颈，阻碍其达到真实规模的模拟：推理时间与内存消耗。

sentences.en: In this work, we address both issues by challenging the long-held belief that the cutoff radius for the MLIP must be held to a fixed, constant value.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们通过挑战一个长期以来的信念来解决这两个问题，即 MLIP 的截断半径必须保持为固定的常数值。

sentences.en: For the first time, we introduce a **dynamic** cutoff formulation that still leads to stable, long timescale molecular dynamics simulation.
sentences.zh: 我们首次引入一种**动态**截断公式，它仍能实现稳定、长时间尺度的分子动力学模拟。

sentences.en: In introducing the dynamic cutoff, we are able to induce sparsity onto the underlying atom graph by targeting a specific number of neighbors per atom, significantly reducing both memory consumption and inference time.
sentences.zh: 通过引入动态截断，我们能够以每个原子的目标邻居数来促使底层原子图变得稀疏，从而显著降低内存消耗和推理时间。

sentences.en: We show the effectiveness of a dynamic cutoff by implementing it onto 4 state of the art MLIPs: MACE, Nequip, Orbv3, and TensorNet, leading to **2.26x** less memory consumption and **2.04x** faster inference time, depending on the model and atomic system.
sentences.zh: 我们将其实现到 4 个最先进的 MLIP 上（MACE、Nequip、Orbv3 和 TensorNet），以此展示动态截断的有效性，根据不同模型和原子体系，内存消耗最多减少 **2.26x**、推理时间最多加快 **2.04x**。

sentences.en: We also perform an extensive error analysis and find that the dynamic cutoff models exhibit minimal accuracy dropoff compared to their fixed cutoff counterparts on both materials and molecular datasets.
sentences.zh: 我们还进行了广泛的误差分析，发现在材料与分子数据集上，与固定截断的对应模型相比，动态截断模型的精度下降极小。

sentences.en: All model implementations and training code will be fully open sourced.
sentences.zh: 所有模型实现与训练代码都将完全开源。

title_en: Smooth Multi-Policy Causal Effect Estimation in Longitudinal Settings
title_zh: 纵向场景中的平滑多策略因果效应估计

sentences.en: Comparative evaluation of *multiple* dynamic treatment policies is essential for healthcare and policy decisions, yet conventional longitudinal causal inference methods estimate each in *isolation*, preventing information sharing across counterfactuals.
sentences.zh: 对*多种*动态治疗策略进行比较评估对于医疗与政策决策至关重要，然而传统的纵向因果推断方法却对每种策略进行*孤立*估计，阻碍了反事实之间的信息共享。

sentences.en: We demonstrate that this separate estimation paradigm induces a structurally uncontrolled second-order bias, inflating finite-sample variance even after standard debiasing with *longitudinal targeted maximum likelihood estimation* (LTMLE).
sentences.zh: 我们证明，这种分离估计范式会引入结构上不受控制的二阶偏差，即便经过基于*纵向靶向最大似然估计*（LTMLE）的标准去偏处理后，仍会放大有限样本方差。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose a policy-aware reparameterization of *Iterative Conditional Expectation* (ICE) Q-functions that enables joint estimation through shared representations.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，我们提出一种对*迭代条件期望*（ICE）Q 函数进行策略感知重参数化的方法，通过共享表示实现联合估计。

sentences.en: We implement this approach in the **Policy-Encoded Q Network (PEQ-Net)**, an architecture centered on a shared policy encoder.
sentences.zh: 我们将该方法实现于**策略编码 Q 网络（PEQ-Net）**中，这是一种以共享策略编码器为核心的架构。

sentences.en: The encoder is trained using kernel mean embeddings, ensuring that the learned representation space reflects population-level policy dissimilarities.
sentences.zh: 该编码器使用核均值嵌入进行训练，确保学习到的表示空间能够反映总体层面的策略差异。

sentences.en: After applying an LTMLE correction step, we prove this design imposes a structural constraint on the second-order remainder, thereby stabilizing finite-sample variance.
sentences.zh: 在应用 LTMLE 校正步骤后，我们证明该设计对二阶余项施加了结构约束，从而稳定了有限样本方差。

sentences.en: Experiments on semi-synthetic datasets demonstrate that PEQ-Net consistently outperforms existing ICE-based methods, achieving substantial reductions in root-mean-square error, particularly when evaluating closely related policies.
sentences.zh: 在半合成数据集上的实验表明，PEQ-Net 持续优于现有的基于 ICE 的方法，在均方根误差上实现了大幅降低，尤其是在评估密切相关的策略时。

title_en: Smoothie: Smoothing Diffusion on Token Embeddings for Text Generation
title_zh: Smoothie：面向文本生成的词元嵌入平滑扩散

sentences.en: Diffusion models have achieved state-of-the-art performance in generating images, audio, and video, but their adaptation to text remains challenging due to its discrete nature.
sentences.zh: 扩散模型已在生成图像、音频和视频方面取得了最先进的性能，但由于文本的离散特性，将其适配到文本仍然具有挑战性。

sentences.en: Prior approaches either apply Gaussian diffusion in continuous latent spaces, which inherits semantic structure but struggles with token decoding, or operate in categorical simplex space, which respect discreteness but disregard semantic relation between tokens.
sentences.zh: 以往的方法要么在连续潜空间中应用高斯扩散（继承了语义结构，但在词元解码上较为吃力），要么在类别单纯形空间中运行（尊重离散性，却忽视了词元之间的语义关系）。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose Smoothing Diffusion on Token Embeddings (Smoothie), a novel diffusion method that combines the strengths of both approaches by progressively smoothing token embeddings based on semantic similarity.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出词元嵌入上的平滑扩散（Smoothie），这是一种新颖的扩散方法，通过基于语义相似性逐步平滑词元嵌入，融合了上述两种方法的优点。

sentences.en: This technique enables gradual information removal while maintaining a natural decoding process.
sentences.zh: 该技术能够在保持自然解码过程的同时，实现信息逐步移除。

sentences.en: Experimental results on several sequence-to-sequence and unconditional generation tasks demonstrate that Smoothie outperforms existing diffusion-based models in generation quality.
sentences.zh: 在多个序列到序列及无条件生成任务上的实验结果表明，Smoothie 在生成质量上优于现有的基于扩散的模型。

sentences.en: Furthermore, ablation studies show that our proposed diffusion space yields better performance than both the standard embedding space and the categorical simplex.
sentences.zh: 此外，消融研究表明，我们提出的扩散空间比标准嵌入空间和类别单纯形都能取得更好的性能。

title_en: Smoothing Slot Attention Iterations and Recurrences
title_zh: 平滑 Slot Attention 的迭代与循环

sentences.en: Slot Attention (SA) lies at the heart of mainstream Object-Centric Learning (OCL).
sentences.zh: Slot Attention（SA）是主流以对象为中心的学习（OCL）的核心。

sentences.en: Image features can be aggregated into object-level representations by SA iteratively refining cold-start query slots.
sentences.zh: 通过 SA 对冷启动查询槽进行迭代细化，可以将图像特征聚合成对象级表示。

sentences.en: For video, such aggregation proceeds by SA recurrently shared across frames, with queries cold-started on the first frame while transitioned from the previous frame's slots thereafter.
sentences.zh: 对于视频，这种聚合通过跨帧共享的 SA 循环进行：查询在第一帧冷启动，此后由前一帧的槽进行过渡。

sentences.en: However, cold-start queries lack sample-specific cues thus hindering precise aggregation on image or video's first frame;
sentences.zh: 然而，冷启动查询缺乏样本特定线索，从而阻碍了在图像或视频首帧上的精确聚合；

sentences.en: Non-first frames' queries are already sample-specific thus requiring aggregation transforms different from the first frame.
sentences.zh: 非首帧的查询已具备样本特定性，因此所需的聚合变换与首帧不同。

sentences.en: We address these issues with our SmoothSA: (1) To smooth SA iterations on image or video's first frame, we preheat cold-start queries with rich input-feature information, by a tiny module self-distilled inside OCL;
sentences.zh: 我们通过 SmoothSA 来解决这些问题：(1) 为使图像或视频首帧上的 SA 迭代更为平滑，我们利用一个在 OCL 内部自蒸馏的微型模块，用丰富的输入特征信息预热冷启动查询；

sentences.en: (2) To smooth SA recurrences across video's first and non-first frames, we differentiate the homogeneous aggregation transforms by using full and single iterations respectively.
sentences.zh: (2) 为使视频首帧与非首帧之间的 SA 循环更为平滑，我们分别使用完整迭代与单次迭代来区分同质的聚合变换。

sentences.en: Comprehensive experiments on object discovery, recognition and visual reasoning validate our method's effectiveness.
sentences.zh: 在对象发现、识别与视觉推理上的全面实验验证了我们方法的有效性。

sentences.en: Further visual analyses illuminate the underline mechanisms.
sentences.zh: 进一步的视觉分析阐明了其潜在机制。

sentences.en: Our source code, model checkpoints and training logs are provided on https://github.com/Genera1Z/SmoothSA.
sentences.zh: 我们的源代码、模型检查点与训练日志可在 https://github.com/Genera1Z/SmoothSA 上获取。

title_en: Smoothness Errors in Dynamics Models and How to Avoid Them
title_zh: 动力学模型中的平滑性误差及其规避方法

sentences.en: Modern neural networks have shown promise for solving partial differential equations over surfaces, often by discretizing the surface as a mesh and learning with a mesh-aware graph neural network.
sentences.zh: 现代神经网络在求解曲面上的偏微分方程方面展现出潜力，通常的做法是将曲面离散为网格，并用网格感知的图神经网络进行学习。

sentences.en: However, graph neural networks suffer from oversmoothing, where a node's features become increasingly similar to those of its neighbors.
sentences.zh: 然而，图神经网络存在过平滑（oversmoothing）问题，即节点的特征会与其邻居的特征越来越相似。

sentences.en: Unitary graph convolutions, which are mathematically constrained to preserve smoothness, have been proposed to address this issue.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，人们提出了在数学上受约束以保持平滑性的酉图卷积。

sentences.en: Despite this, in many physical systems, such as diffusion processes, smoothness naturally increases and unitarity may be overconstraining.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，在许多物理系统（如扩散过程）中，平滑性会自然增强，此时酉约束可能过度受限。

sentences.en: In this paper, we systematically study the smoothing effects of different GNNs for dynamics modeling and prove that unitary convolutions hurt performance for such tasks.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们系统研究了不同 GNN 在动力学建模中的平滑效应，并证明酉卷积会损害此类任务的性能。

sentences.en: We propose relaxed unitary convolutions that balance smoothness preservation with the natural smoothing required for physical systems.
sentences.zh: 我们提出松弛酉卷积，在保持平滑性与物理系统所需的自然平滑之间取得平衡。

sentences.en: We also generalize unitary and relaxed unitary convolutions from graphs to meshes.
sentences.zh: 我们还将酉卷积与松弛酉卷积从图推广到网格。

sentences.en: In experiments on PDEs such as the heat and wave equations over complex meshes and on weather forecasting, we find that our method outperforms several strong baselines, including mesh-aware transformers and equivariant neural networks.
sentences.zh: 在复杂网格上的热方程、波动方程等 PDE 实验以及天气预报实验中，我们发现我们的方法优于多个强基线，包括网格感知的 Transformer 和等变神经网络。

sentences.en: Our code is available at github.com/EdwardBerman/rayleigh_analysis
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 github.com/EdwardBerman/rayleigh_analysis 获取。

title_en: SmoothSpike: Spiking Transformer with Learnable Hadamard Transformation
title_zh: SmoothSpike：带可学习阿达玛变换的脉冲 Transformer

sentences.en: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) that leverage sparse binary spikes and temporal dynamics have emerged as energy-efficient alternatives to Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs).
sentences.zh: 利用稀疏二元脉冲与时间动力学的脉冲神经网络（SNN）已成为人工神经网络（ANN）的节能替代方案。

sentences.en: However, SNNs suffer from limited representational capacity due to the discrete nature of spikes.
sentences.zh: 然而，由于脉冲的离散特性，SNN 的表示能力受到限制。

sentences.en: Existing solutions extending spike levels often overlook the constraints of the simulation time window, leading to a critical issue we identify as spike saturation-induced information homogenization.
sentences.zh: 现有的扩展脉冲层级的方案往往忽视了仿真时间窗口的约束，从而引发了一个我们称之为脉冲饱和导致的信息同质化的关键问题。

sentences.en: In this phenomenon, distinct high-amplitude inputs result in identical maximized spike counts, truncating the dynamic range and hindering the model’s ability to capture fine-grained semantic differences.
sentences.zh: 在该现象中，不同的高幅度输入会得到相同的最大化脉冲计数，截断了动态范围，并阻碍模型捕获细粒度语义差异的能力。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose SmoothSpike, a novel method designed to enhance representational capacity by suppressing spike saturation.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出 SmoothSpike，一种通过抑制脉冲饱和来增强表示能力的新方法。

sentences.en: We first introduce a randomized Hadamard transformation to smooth neuronal inputs, theoretically proving its efficacy in constraining extreme values and reducing both saturation probability and input variability among saturated neurons.
sentences.zh: 我们首先引入随机阿达玛变换来平滑神经元输入，并从理论上证明其在约束极值、降低饱和概率以及减小饱和神经元间输入变异性方面的有效性。

sentences.en: To further improve adaptability, we evolve this into a learnable orthogonal transformation.
sentences.zh: 为了进一步提升适应性，我们将其演进为一种可学习的正交变换。

sentences.en: Initialized with Hadamard matrices and maintained orthogonal via Newton-Schulz iteration, this module dynamically adapts to varying input distributions during training.
sentences.zh: 该模块以阿达玛矩阵初始化，并通过 Newton-Schulz 迭代维持正交性，在训练过程中动态适应变化的输入分布。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on language modeling tasks show that SmoothSpike effectively mitigates the information homogenization problem and improves task performance.
sentences.zh: 在语言建模任务上的大量实验表明，SmoothSpike 能有效缓解信息同质化问题并提升任务性能。

sentences.en: This positions SmoothSpike as a robust solution to bridge the performance gap between SNNs and ANNs.
sentences.zh: 这使得 SmoothSpike 成为弥合 SNN 与 ANN 之间性能差距的稳健方案。

title_en: Sobolev Regularized Score Difference Estimation in Diffusion Models
title_zh: 扩散模型中的 Sobolev 正则化得分差估计

sentences.en: Estimating the difference of two Stein's score functions is a fundamental problem in generative modeling.
sentences.zh: 估计两个 Stein 得分函数之差是生成建模中的一个基本问题。

sentences.en: In particular, score differences arise naturally in transfer learning, where the score difference provides the mechanism for adapting a pre-trained model to a new target distribution, and in diffusion model-based post-training methods such as discriminator guidance.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，得分差在迁移学习中自然出现——得分差为将预训练模型适配到新的目标分布提供了机制；它同样出现在基于扩散模型的后训练方法（如判别器引导）中。

sentences.en: Existing estimators for score differences in these settings either lack of statistical consistency or are difficult to scale up in high-dimensions.
sentences.zh: 在这些设定下，现有的得分差估计器要么缺乏统计一致性，要么难以在高维中扩展。

sentences.en: We propose a statistically consistent and scalable estimator for score differences based on Sobolev regularization, which plays a crucial role in ensuring consistency and stablizing the training in the small-sample regime.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一种基于 Sobolev 正则化的、具有统计一致性且可扩展的得分差估计器，该正则化在保证一致性以及稳定小样本情形下的训练方面起着关键作用。

sentences.en: Mathematically, we establish a convergence rate of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(n^{-\frac{s-1}{d+2s-2}})$ where $d$ is the  dimension and $s$ denotes the smoothness of the underlying densities, and provide a minimax lower bound of $\tilde{\Omega}(n^{-\frac{2(s-1)}{d+2s}})$ (in mean-squared error).
sentences.zh: 在数学上，我们建立了 $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(n^{-\frac{s-1}{d+2s-2}})$ 的收敛速度（其中 $d$ 是维度，$s$ 表示底层密度的光滑度），并给出 $\tilde{\Omega}(n^{-\frac{2(s-1)}{d+2s}})$ 的极小极大下界（以均方误差计）。

sentences.en: Empirically, our estimator exhibits significantly improved stability in small-sample regimes compared to existing methods.
sentences.zh: 在实验上，与现有方法相比，我们的估计器在小样本情形中展现出显著提升的稳定性。

sentences.en: We demonstrate its effectiveness on real-world tasks, including transfer learning for ECG signal generation, where it substantially outperforms non-regularized score difference estimators in downstream classification performance.
sentences.zh: 我们在真实世界任务上展示了其有效性，包括用于 ECG 信号生成的迁移学习，在该任务中，它在下游分类性能上大幅优于未正则化的得分差估计器。

title_en: Social Hippocampus Memory Learning
title_zh: 社会海马体记忆学习

sentences.en: Social learning highlights that learning agents improve not in isolation, but through interaction and structured knowledge exchange with others.
sentences.zh: 社会学习强调，学习主体并非在孤立中提升，而是通过与他人的互动和结构化知识交换得到改进。

sentences.en: When introduced into machine learning, this principle gives rise to social machine learning (SML), where multiple agents collaboratively learn by sharing abstracted knowledge.
sentences.zh: 当这一原则被引入机器学习时，便催生了社会机器学习（SML），即多个主体通过共享抽象化的知识进行协作学习。

sentences.en: Federated learning (FL) provides a natural collaboration substrate for this paradigm, yet existing heterogeneous FL approaches often rely on sharing model parameters or intermediate representations, which may expose sensitive information and incur additional overhead.
sentences.zh: 联邦学习（FL）为此范式提供了自然的协作基础，然而现有的异构 FL 方法往往依赖于共享模型参数或中间表示，这可能泄露敏感信息并带来额外开销。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose **SoHip** (**So**cial **Hip**pocampus Memory Learning), a memory-centric social machine learning framework that enables collaboration among heterogeneous agents via memory sharing rather than model sharing.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出**SoHip**（**So**cial **Hip**pocampus Memory Learning，即社会海马体记忆学习），这是一种以记忆为中心的社会机器学习框架，通过记忆共享而非模型共享，实现异构主体之间的协作。

sentences.en: SoHip abstracts each agent’s individual short-term memory from local representations, consolidates it into individual long-term memory through a hippocampus-inspired mechanism, and fuses it with collectively aggregated long-term memory to enhance local prediction.
sentences.zh: SoHip 从局部表示中抽象出每个主体的个体短期记忆，通过受海马体启发的机制将其固化为个体长期记忆，并将其与集体聚合的长期记忆相融合，以增强局部预测。

sentences.en: Throughout the process, raw data and local models remain on-device, while only lightweight memory are exchanged.
sentences.zh: 在整个过程中，原始数据与局部模型始终保留在设备端，仅交换轻量级的记忆。

sentences.en: We provide theoretical analysis on convergence and privacy preservation properties.
sentences.zh: 我们对收敛性与隐私保护性质提供了理论分析。

sentences.en: Experiments on two benchmark datasets with seven baselines demonstrate that SoHip consistently outperforms existing methods, achieving up to 8.78% accuracy improvements.
sentences.zh: 在两个基准数据集上、与七个基线的实验中，SoHip 持续优于现有方法，准确率提升最高达 8.78%。

sentences.en: The code of SoHip is available at https://github.com/LipingYi/SoHip.
sentences.zh: SoHip 的代码可在 https://github.com/LipingYi/SoHip 获取。

title_en: SoftBinary Coding: A New Information-Theoretic Paradigm for Neural Compression via Fast Channel Simulation
title_zh: SoftBinary 编码：通过快速信道模拟实现神经压缩的新信息论范式

sentences.en: Neural compression is currently dominated by Nonlinear Transform Coding (NTC), which maps data to real-valued latents via continuous transforms.
sentences.zh: 神经压缩目前以非线性变换编码（NTC）为主导，它通过连续变换将数据映射到实值潜变量。

sentences.en: Despite its success, NTC suffers from train-test mismatch due to non-differentiable quantization, a "smoothness bias" inherent in continuous transforms that precludes optimality for certain sources, and a loss of "shaping gain" due to its use of scalar quantization.
sentences.zh: 尽管取得了成功，NTC 仍存在以下问题：由不可微量化导致的训练-测试不匹配、连续变换固有的“平滑性偏差”（对某些信源无法达到最优），以及因使用标量量化而造成的“整形增益”损失。

sentences.en: We propose SoftBinary Coding (SBC), an end-to-end learning paradigm that bypasses these limitations by using a stochastic binary latent space.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 SoftBinary 编码（SBC），这是一种端到端的学习范式，通过使用随机二元潜空间来绕开这些局限。

sentences.en: In the spirit of vector quantization, SBC employs discrete representations and compresses them through a novel fast binary channel simulation scheme, for which we provide a proof of rate optimality.
sentences.zh: 秉承矢量量化的精神，SBC 使用离散表示，并通过一种新颖的快速二元信道模拟方案对其进行压缩，我们为此提供了速率最优性的证明。

sentences.en: Experimental gains on information-theoretic sources address NTC's limitations both theoretically and practically, establishing discrete binary structures as a viable path toward reaching optimal rate–distortion bounds.
sentences.zh: 在信息论信源上的实验收益从理论与实践两方面回应了 NTC 的局限，确立了离散二元结构作为达到最优率失真界的可行路径。

sentences.en: Surprisingly, SBC also achieves state-of-the-art performance on vector quantization of i.i.d. sources, exceeding Trellis Coded Quantization of the Gaussian source.
sentences.zh: 令人惊讶的是，SBC 在 i.i.d.（独立同分布）信源的矢量量化上也取得了最先进的性能，超越了高斯信源的网格编码量化（Trellis Coded Quantization）。

title_en: SoftJAX & SoftTorch: Empowering Automatic Differentiation Libraries with Informative Gradients
title_zh: SoftJAX 与 SoftTorch：以信息丰富的梯度赋能自动微分库

sentences.en: Automatic differentiation (AD) frameworks such as JAX and PyTorch have enabled gradient-based optimization for a wide range of scientific fields.
sentences.zh: 诸如 JAX 与 PyTorch 等自动微分（AD）框架，已在众多科学领域实现了基于梯度的优化。

sentences.en: Yet, many ''hard'' primitives in these libraries such as thresholding, Boolean logic, discrete indexing, and sorting operations yield zero or undefined gradients that are not useful for optimization.
sentences.zh: 然而，这些库中的许多“hard”原语（如阈值处理、布尔逻辑、离散索引和排序操作）会产生零或未定义的梯度，对优化没有用处。

sentences.en: While numerous ''soft'' relaxations have been proposed that provide informative gradients, the respective implementations are fragmented across projects, making them difficult to combine and compare.
sentences.zh: 尽管已有众多能提供信息丰富梯度的“soft”松弛方法被提出，但它们的实现分散在各个项目中，难以组合与比较。

sentences.en: This work introduces **SoftJAX** and **SoftTorch**, open-source, feature-complete libraries for *soft differentiable programming*.
sentences.zh: 本工作提出 **SoftJAX** 与 **SoftTorch**，它们是用于*soft differentiable programming*的开源、功能完备的库。

sentences.en: These libraries provide a variety of soft functions as drop-in replacements for their hard JAX and PyTorch counterparts.
sentences.zh: 这些库提供了多种软函数，作为其在 JAX 和 PyTorch 中对应硬函数的即插即用替代品。

sentences.en: This includes (i) elementwise operators such as *clip* or *abs*, (ii) utility methods for manipulating Booleans and indices via fuzzy logic, (iii) axiswise operators such as *sort* or *rank* -- based on optimal transport or permutahedron projections, and (iv) offer full support for straight-through gradient estimation.
sentences.zh: 这包括 (i) 逐元素算子（如 *clip* 或 *abs*）；(ii) 通过模糊逻辑操作布尔量与索引的实用方法；(iii) 基于最优传输或置换体投影的按轴算子（如 *sort* 或 *rank*）；以及 (iv) 对直通梯度估计的完整支持。

sentences.en: Overall, SoftJAX and SoftTorch make the toolbox of soft relaxations easily accessible to differentiable programming, as demonstrated through benchmarking and a practical case study.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，SoftJAX 与 SoftTorch 使软松弛工具箱能轻松用于可微编程，这一点已通过基准测试和一个实际案例研究得到展示。

title_en: SoftMatcha 2: A Fast and Soft Pattern Matcher for Trillion-Scale Corpora
title_zh: SoftMatcha 2：面向万亿级语料库的快速软模式匹配器

sentences.en: We present SoftMatcha 2, an ultra-fast and flexible search algorithm that enables search over trillion-scale natural language corpora in under 0.3 seconds while allowing semantic variations in the form of substitution, insertion, and deletion.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 SoftMatcha 2，一种超快且灵活的检索算法，它能在 0.3 秒内完成对万亿级自然语言语料库的检索，同时允许以替换、插入和删除的形式进行语义变化。

sentences.en: Our approach employs string matching based on suffix arrays that scales well with corpus size, and represents words as vectors, which underpin its semantic flexibility.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法采用基于后缀数组的字符串匹配，能与语料规模良好扩展，并将词表示为向量，从而奠定其语义灵活性。

sentences.en: To mitigate the combinatorial explosion induced by the semantic relaxation of queries, our method is built on two key algorithmic ideas: dynamic corpus-aware pruning and fast exact lookup enabled by a disk-aware design.
sentences.zh: 为缓解查询语义松弛带来的组合爆炸，我们的方法建立在两个关键算法思想之上：动态的语料感知剪枝，以及由磁盘感知设计实现的高速精确查找。

sentences.en: We theoretically analyze the efficiency of the proposed method, indicating that it can mitigate exponential growth in the search space.
sentences.zh: 我们从理论上分析了所提方法的效率，表明它能够缓解搜索空间中的指数增长。

sentences.en: Empirically, on FineWeb-Edu (Lozhkov et al., 2024) (1.4T tokens), it attains substantially lower search latency than existing methods: infini-gram (Liu et al., 2024), infini-gram mini (Xu et al., 2025), and SoftMatcha (Deguchi et al., 2025).
sentences.zh: 在实验上，对于 FineWeb-Edu（Lozhkov 等，2024）（1.4T token），它获得的检索延迟显著低于现有方法：infini-gram（Liu 等，2024）、infini-gram mini（Xu 等，2025）和 SoftMatcha（Deguchi 等，2025）。

sentences.en: As a practical application, our method uncovers benchmark contamination in training corpora that existing approaches miss, and it also benefits information retrieval and paraphrase detection.
sentences.zh: 作为一项实际应用，我们的方法能发现现有方法遗漏的训练语料基准污染，同时也使信息检索和改写检测受益。

sentences.en: We also provide an online demo of fast, soft search across corpora in seven languages.
sentences.zh: 我们还提供了在七种语言语料库上进行快速软检索的在线演示。

title_en: Softmax as Linear Attention in the Large-Prompt Regime: a Measure-based Perspective
title_zh: 大提示场景下作为线性注意力的 Softmax：一种基于测度的视角

sentences.en: Softmax attention is a central component of transformer architectures, yet its nonlinear structure poses significant challenges for theoretical analysis.
sentences.zh: Softmax 注意力是 Transformer 架构的核心组件，然而其非线性结构给理论分析带来了重大挑战。

sentences.en: We develop a unified, measure-based framework for studying single-layer softmax attention under both finite and infinite prompts.
sentences.zh: 我们发展了一个统一的、基于测度的框架，用于研究有限与无限提示下的单层 Softmax 注意力。

sentences.en: For i.i.d. centered Gaussian inputs, we lean on the fact that the softmax operator converges in the infinite-prompt limit to a linear operator acting on the underlying input-token measure.
sentences.zh: 对于 i.i.d.（独立同分布）中心高斯输入，我们依据以下事实：在无限提示极限下，softmax 算子收敛为作用于底层输入词元测度的线性算子。

sentences.en: Building on this insight, we establish non-asymptotic concentration bounds for the output and gradient of softmax attention, quantifying how rapidly the finite-prompt model approaches its infinite-prompt counterpart, and prove that this concentration remains stable along the entire training trajectory in general in-context learning settings with sub-Gaussian tokens.
sentences.zh: 基于这一洞见，我们为 softmax 注意力的输出与梯度建立了非渐近集中界，量化了有限提示模型趋近其无限提示对应物的速度，并证明在具有亚高斯词元的一般上下文学习设定中，这种集中性沿着整个训练轨迹保持稳定。

sentences.en: In the case of in-context linear regression, we use the tractable infinite-prompt dynamics to analyze training at finite prompt length.
sentences.zh: 在上下文线性回归的情形中，我们利用易处理的无限提示动力学来分析有限提示长度下的训练。

sentences.en: Our results allow optimization analyses developed for linear attention to transfer directly to softmax attention when prompts are sufficiently long, showing that large-prompt softmax attention inherits the analytical structure of its linear counterpart.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果使得当提示足够长时，为线性注意力开发的优化分析能够直接迁移到 softmax 注意力，表明大提示 softmax 注意力继承了其线性对应物的解析结构。

sentences.en: This, in turn, provides a principled and broadly applicable toolkit for studying the training dynamics and statistical behavior of softmax attention layers in large prompt regimes.
sentences.zh: 这反过来又为大提示场景下研究 softmax 注意力层的训练动力学与统计行为提供了一个有原则且广泛适用的工具包。

title_en: SoftMoE: Soft Differentiable Routing for Mixture-of-Experts in LLMs
title_zh: SoftMoE：面向 LLM 混合专家模型的软可微路由

sentences.en: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures enable scaling LLM parameters under a fixed inference budget by activating only a small subset of experts via top-$k$ routing.
sentences.zh: 稀疏混合专家（MoE）架构通过 top-$k$ 路由仅激活一小部分专家，从而在固定推理预算下实现 LLM 参数的规模化。

sentences.en: While this preserves causality and suits autoregressive language models, the discrete top-$k$ operator is not differentiable, forcing a fixed number of active experts per input and resulting in inefficient use of computation.
sentences.zh: 虽然这保持了因果性并适合自回归语言模型，但离散的 top-$k$ 算子不可微，迫使每个输入激活固定数量的专家，导致计算利用效率低下。

sentences.en: We propose SoftMoE, which replaces discrete routing with a truncated soft top-$k$ LapSum relaxation, allowing gradient-based optimization of expert routing.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 SoftMoE，它用截断的软 top-$k$ LapSum 松弛替代离散路由，从而实现对专家路由的基于梯度的优化。

sentences.en: We further parameterize the mean number of active experts per layer and impose a global budget constraint, enabling the model to learn how to allocate expert capacity across layers.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步将每层平均激活专家数参数化，并施加全局预算约束，使模型能够学习如何在各层之间分配专家容量。

sentences.en: SoftMoE remains fully compatible with autoregressive modeling and achieves performance comparable to or better than sparse MoE on language modeling and downstream tasks, while activating significantly fewer experts.
sentences.zh: SoftMoE 与自回归建模保持完全兼容，在语言建模与下游任务上达到与稀疏 MoE 相当或更好的性能，同时激活的专家数量显著更少。

sentences.en: Notably, the learned allocation is highly non-uniform, with later layers activating more experts.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，学到的分配高度不均匀：靠后的层会激活更多专家。

sentences.en: The source code is publicly available$^\dagger$.
sentences.zh: 源代码已公开，见 $^\dagger$。

title_en: Softplus Attention with Re-weighting Boosts Length Extrapolation in Large Language Models
title_zh: 带重新加权的 Softplus 注意力提升大语言模型的长度外推能力

sentences.en: Large language models have achieved remarkable success in recent years,     primarily due to self-attention.
sentences.zh: 近年来，大语言模型取得了显著成功，这主要归功于自注意力。

sentences.en: However,     traditional Softmax attention suffers from numerical instability and     reduced performance as the number of inference tokens increases.
sentences.zh: 然而，随着推理 token 数量的增加，传统的 Softmax 注意力会出现数值不稳定和性能下降的问题。

sentences.en: This work     addresses these issues by proposing a new design principle for attention,     viewing it as a two-stage process.
sentences.zh: 本工作通过提出一种新的注意力设计原则来解决这些问题，将注意力视为一个两阶段过程。

sentences.en: The first stage (normalisation) refines standard attention by replacing Softmax with the more numerically stable Softplus followed by     $l_{1}$-normalisation.
sentences.zh: 第一阶段（归一化）通过用数值更稳定的 Softplus 替代 Softmax，随后进行 $l_{1}$-归一化，来改进标准注意力。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we introduce a dynamic scale factor based on invariance entropy.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们引入一个基于不变熵的动态缩放因子。

sentences.en: We show that this novel attention mechanism outperforms conventional Softmax attention, and state-of-the-art Softmax-free alternatives.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，这种新颖的注意力机制优于传统的 Softmax 注意力以及最先进的无 Softmax 方案。

sentences.en: Our second proposal is to introduce a second processing stage (sharpening) which consists of a     re-weighting mechanism that     amplifies significant attentional weights while diminishing weaker ones.
sentences.zh: 我们的第二个提议是引入第二个处理阶段（锐化），它由一个重新加权机制组成，该机制放大重要的注意力权重，同时削弱较弱的权重。

sentences.en: This enables     the model to concentrate more effectively on relevant tokens, mitigating     the attention sink phenomenon, and fundamentally improving length extrapolation.
sentences.zh: 这使模型能够更有效地聚焦于相关 token，缓解注意力汇聚（attention sink）现象，并从根本上升级长度外推能力。

sentences.en: This novel, two-stage, replacement for self-attention is shown to ensure numerical stability and dramatically     improve length extrapolation, maintaining a nearly constant validation     loss at 16$\times$ the training length while achieving superior results on     challenging long-context retrieval tasks and downstream benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 这种新颖的两阶段自注意力替代方案被证明能确保数值稳定性，并大幅提升长度外推能力：在 16$\times$ 训练长度下仍能保持近乎恒定的验证损失，同时在具有挑战性的长上下文检索任务和下游基准上取得优异结果。

sentences.en: Furthermore, symbolic regression experiments demonstrate that our method enables     models to recover Newton's gravitational law from orbital trajectory sequences,     providing evidence that appropriate attention mechanisms are crucial for     foundation models to develop genuine physical world models.
sentences.zh: 此外，符号回归实验表明，我们的方法使模型能够从轨道轨迹序列中恢复牛顿万有引力定律，这提供了证据表明：恰当的注意力机制对于基础模型形成真正的物理世界模型至关重要。

sentences.en: Our code is     available at https://github.com/iminfine/freeattn .
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/iminfine/freeattn 获取。

title_en: Softsign: Smooth Sign in Your Optimizer For Better Parameter Heterogeneity Handling
title_zh: Softsign：优化器中的平滑符号函数以更好地处理参数异构性

sentences.en: Sign-based and LMO-inspired optimizers have recently attracted substantial attention in deep learning due to their strong performance and low memory footprint.
sentences.zh: 基于符号的优化器以及受 LMO 启发的优化器，凭借其强劲的性能和低内存占用，近年来在深度学习中引起了广泛关注。

sentences.en: However, their fixed-magnitude updates can hurt terminal convergence: they decouple update mechanisms from gradient magnitudes and fail to account for parameter heterogeneity, often leading to oscillation rather than convergence.
sentences.zh: 然而，它们固定幅度的更新会损害最终收敛：更新机制与梯度幅度解耦，且未考虑参数异构性，往往导致振荡而非收敛。

sentences.en: We propose SoftSignum, a smooth relaxation of sign-based optimization that replaces the hard sign map with a temperature-controlled soft-sign transformation, enabling a parameter-wise transition from sign-like updates to magnitude-sensitive SGD-like steps.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 SoftSignum，它是基于符号优化的一种平滑松弛，用温度控制的软符号变换替代硬符号映射，使每个参数能够从类符号更新过渡到对幅度敏感的类 SGD 步长。

sentences.en: We complement it with an adaptive quantile-based temperature schedule and extend the same principle to matrix-valued optimizers, obtaining SoftMuon.
sentences.zh: 我们为其补充了基于自适应分位数的温度调度，并将同一原则扩展到矩阵值优化器，得到 SoftMuon。

sentences.en: We also develop a generalized geometry-relaxation framework based on strongly convex regularizers and Fenchel conjugates, proving convergence in stochastic non-convex setting.
sentences.zh: 我们还开发了一个基于强凸正则化器与 Fenchel 共轭的广义几何松弛框架，并证明了在随机非凸设定下的收敛性。

sentences.en: Experiments on diverse deep learning tasks, including LLM pretraining, show that SoftSignum and SoftMuon consistently improve over their hard sign-based counterparts and standard AdamW.
sentences.zh: 在包括 LLM 预训练在内的多种深度学习任务上的实验表明，SoftSignum 和 SoftMuon 持续优于其硬符号对应物以及标准 AdamW。

title_en: SOLAR for Offline MARL: Plateau-Triggered Potential Shaping under World-Model Uncertainty
title_zh: 面向离线 MARL 的 SOLAR：世界模型不确定性下的平台期触发势塑造

sentences.en: Reward shaping can accelerate reinforcement learning, but in sparse-reward \emph{offline} multi-agent RL it is often brittle: dense intrinsic rewards may alter the underlying Markov game, while world-model guidance can amplify model bias.
sentences.zh: 奖励塑造可以加速强化学习，但在稀疏奖励的 \emph{offline} 多智能体 RL 中，它往往很脆弱：密集的内在奖励可能改变底层马尔可夫博弈，而世界模型引导可能放大模型偏差。

sentences.en: We find that shaping becomes reliable when it is (i) activated only after \emph{statistically validated} learning plateaus and (ii) constrained to \emph{potential-based} shaping, which preserves the task optimum.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，当满足以下条件时，塑造会变得可靠：(i) 仅在\emph{statistically validated}的学习平台期之后激活；(ii) 被约束为\emph{potential-based}的塑造，从而保持任务的最优性。

sentences.en: Motivated by this, we propose \textsc{SOLAR}, a simulate--evaluate--shape framework.
sentences.zh: 受此启发，我们提出 \textsc{SOLAR}，一个模拟--评估--塑造框架。

sentences.en: A learned world model enables low-cost rollouts to test plateaus; once a plateau is detected, we inject shaping in the form $r+\gamma\Phi(s')-\Phi(s)$ with adaptively updated potentials; and we attenuate shaping using uncertainty-aware throttling in unreliable regions.
sentences.zh: 学习到的世界模型支持以低成本 rollout 来测试平台期；一旦检测到平台期，我们以 $r+\gamma\Phi(s')-\Phi(s)$ 的形式注入塑造，并使用自适应更新的势；在不可靠区域，我们还通过不确定性感知的节流来减弱塑造。

sentences.en: We provide theoretical analysis on policy invariance and on the deviation of plateau decisions under model error, and establish stability for the resulting two-timescale adaptation.
sentences.zh: 我们就策略不变性以及在模型误差下平台期决策的偏差提供了理论分析，并为由此产生的两时间尺度自适应建立了稳定性。

sentences.en: Experiments on sparse-reward offline MARL benchmarks show consistent gains in stability and final performance across dataset qualities.
sentences.zh: 在稀疏奖励的离线 MARL 基准上的实验表明，在不同数据质量下，稳定性和最终性能都取得了一致的提升。

title_en: SOLAR: Self-supervised Joint Learning for Symmetric Multimodal Retrieval
title_zh: SOLAR：面向对称多模态检索的自监督联合学习

sentences.en: In this work, we address the critical yet underexplored challenge of symmetric multimodal-to-multimodal (MM2MM) retrieval, where queries and contexts are interchangeable.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们应对对称多模态到多模态（MM2MM）检索这一关键但尚未被充分探索的挑战，在该任务中查询与上下文可以互换。

sentences.en: Existing universal multimodal retrieval works struggle with this task, as they are constrained by the labeled asymmetric datasets used.
sentences.zh: 现有的通用多模态检索方法在此任务上表现不佳，因为它们受限于所使用的带标注的非对称数据集。

sentences.en: We produce SOLAR (Self-supervised jOint LeArning for symmetric multimodal Retrieval), a novel two-stage self-supervised framework that leverages readily available unlabeled web-scale image-text pairs.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 SOLAR（面向对称多模态检索的自监督联合学习），一种新颖的两阶段自监督框架，利用现成的、无需标注的万维网规模图文对。

sentences.en: Based on the observation that both semantic alignment and discrepancies exist between two modalities, in the first stage, we learn the intersection mask of image-text pair, allowing us to align intersection while preserving semantic of difference.
sentences.zh: 基于两种模态之间同时存在语义对齐与语义差异这一观察，在第一阶段，我们学习图文对的交集掩码，从而在保留差异语义的同时对齐交集部分。

sentences.en: In the second stage, the learned mask is further utilized to construct positive and hardnegative samples via masking different parts of image/text, which enable us to conduct self-supervised multimodal embedding learning.
sentences.zh: 在第二阶段，学习到的掩码被进一步用于通过掩蔽图像/文本的不同部分来构造正样本与难负样本，从而使我们能够进行自监督的多模态嵌入学习。

sentences.en: Complementing this framework, we present a new benchmark featuring high-quality human-verified positive and hard-negative pairs to evaluate symmetric MM2MM retrieval under realistic conditions, as well as the corresponding pipeline.
sentences.zh: 作为该框架的补充，我们提出了一个新基准，其中包含高质量、经人工核验的正样本与难负样本对，用于在现实条件下评估对称 MM2MM 检索，并提供相应的处理流程。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments against ten SOTA methods show SOLAR surpasses the strongest supervised VLM by 7.08 points on this benchmark, with over 50x fewer model parameters and a 5x smaller embedding dimension.
sentences.zh: 与十种 SOTA 方法进行的大量实验表明，在该基准上，SOLAR 以超过 50x 更少的模型参数和 5x 更小的嵌入维度，仍比最强监督 VLM 高出 7.08 分。

sentences.en: Code, model and benchmark are available at [https://github.com/codefuse-ai/SOLAR](https://github.com/codefuse-ai/SOLAR).
sentences.zh: 代码、模型与基准可在 [https://github.com/codefuse-ai/SOLAR](https://github.com/codefuse-ai/SOLAR) 获取。

title_en: Solving Imperfect-Recall Games via Sum-of-Squares Optimization
title_zh: 借助平方和优化求解非完美记忆博弈

sentences.en: Extensive-form games (EFGs) provide a powerful framework for modeling sequential decision making, capturing strategic interaction under imperfect information, chance events, and temporal structure.
sentences.zh: 扩展式博弈（EFG）为建模序列决策提供了强有力的框架，能够刻画不完全信息、机会事件与时间结构下的策略互动。

sentences.en: Most positive algorithmic and theoretical results for EFGs assume perfect recall, where players remember all past information and actions.
sentences.zh: 关于 EFG 的大多数正面算法与理论结果都假设完美记忆，即玩家记得过去所有的信息与行动。

sentences.en: We study the increasingly relevant setting of imperfect-recall EFGs (IREFGs), where players may forget parts of their history or previously acquired information, and where equilibrium computation is provably hard.
sentences.zh: 我们研究日益重要的非完美记忆 EFG（IREFG）设定：玩家可能遗忘部分历史或先前获取的信息，并且在此情形下均衡计算被证明是困难的。

sentences.en: We propose sum-of-squares (SOS) hierarchies for computing ex-ante optimal strategies in single-player IREFGs and Nash equilibria in multi-player IREFGs, working over behavioral strategies.
sentences.zh: 我们提出平方和（SOS）层级方法，用于在行为策略上计算单人 IREFG 的事前最优策略以及多人 IREFG 的纳什均衡。

sentences.en: Our theoretical results show that (i) these hierarchies converge asymptotically, (ii) under genericity assumptions, the convergence is finite, and (iii) in single-player non-absentminded IREFGs, convergence occurs at a finite level determined by the number of information sets.
sentences.zh: 我们的理论结果表明：(i) 这些层级渐进收敛；(ii) 在一般性假设下，收敛是有限的；(iii) 在单人非心不在焉 IREFG 中，收敛发生在由信息集数量决定的有限层级。

sentences.en: Finally, we introduce the new classes of (SOS)-concave and (SOS)-monotone IREFGs, and show that in the single-player setting the SOS hierarchy converges at the first level, enabling equilibrium computation with a single semidefinite program (SDP).
sentences.zh: 最后，我们引入 (SOS)-concave 与 (SOS)-monotone IREFG 这两个新类别，并证明在单人设定下，SOS 层级在第一层即收敛，从而只需一个半定规划（SDP）即可实现均衡计算。

title_en: Solving Inverse Problems with Flow-based Models via Model Predictive Control
title_zh: 通过模型预测控制利用基于流的模型求解逆问题

sentences.en: Flow-based generative models provide strong unconditional priors for inverse problems, but guiding their dynamics for conditional generation remains challenging.
sentences.zh: 基于流的生成模型为逆问题提供了强有力的无条件先验，但引导其动力学进行条件生成仍然具有挑战性。

sentences.en: Recent work casts training-free conditional generation in flow models as an optimal control problem; however, solving the resulting trajectory optimisation is computationally and memory intensive, requiring differentiation through the flow dynamics or adjoint solves.
sentences.zh: 近期工作将流模型中的免训练条件生成表述为最优控制问题；然而，求解由此产生的轨迹优化在计算和内存上都很吃紧，需要对流动力学求微分或进行伴随求解。

sentences.en: We propose MPC-Flow, a model predictive control framework that formulates inverse problem solving with flow-based generative models as a sequence of control sub-problems, enabling practical optimal control-based guidance at inference time.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 MPC-Flow，一个模型预测控制框架，它将基于流的生成模型求解逆问题表述为一系列控制子问题，从而在推理时实现实用的基于最优控制的引导。

sentences.en: We provide theoretical analysis linking MPC-Flow to the underlying optimal control objective and show how different algorithmic choices yield a spectrum of guidance algorithms, including regimes that avoid backpropagation through the generative model trajectory.
sentences.zh: 我们提供了将 MPC-Flow 与底层最优控制目标联系起来的理论分析，并展示了不同的算法选择如何产生一系列引导算法，其中包括避免对生成模型轨迹进行反向传播的模式。

sentences.en: We evaluate MPC-Flow on benchmark image restoration tasks, spanning linear and non-linear settings such as in-painting, deblurring, and super-resolution, and demonstrate strong performance and scalability to massive state-of-the-art architectures via training-free guidance of FLUX.2 (32B) in a quantised setting on consumer hardware.
sentences.zh: 我们在基准图像复原任务上评估 MPC-Flow，涵盖图像修复、去模糊和超分辨率等线性与非线性设定，并通过在消费级硬件上以量化设定对 FLUX.2（32B）进行免训练引导，展示了强劲的性能以及向大规模最先进架构扩展的能力。

title_en: Solving Positive Linear Programs with Differential Privacy
title_zh: 求解具有差分隐私的正线性规划

sentences.en: We study differentially private approximation algorithms for positive linear programs (LPs with nonnegative coefficients and variables), focusing on the fundamental families of packing, covering, and mixed packing-covering formulations.
sentences.zh: 我们研究针对正线性规划（系数与变量均非负的线性规划）的差分隐私近似算法，重点关注装箱（packing）、覆盖（covering）以及混合装箱-覆盖这三类基本问题族。

sentences.en: We focus on the high-sensitivity, constraint-private regime of Hsu-Roth-Roughgarden-Ullman (ICALP 2014), where neighboring instances may differ by an arbitrary single constraint, so one cannot hope to approximately satisfy every constraint under privacy.
sentences.zh: 我们聚焦于 Hsu-Roth-Roughgarden-Ullman（ICALP 2014）提出的高敏感、约束私密设定：在此设定中，相邻实例可能仅相差任意单个约束，因此在隐私约束下，人们无法期望近似满足每一条约束。

sentences.en: We give private solvers that return approximate solutions while violating only a controlled number of constraints.
sentences.zh: 我们给出的私有求解器在仅违反有限数量约束的情况下返回近似解。

sentences.en: Our algorithms improve the prior instance-dependent guarantees, and also yield new data-independent bounds that depend only on the dimension.
sentences.zh: 我们的算法改进了先前与实例相关的保证，并给出了仅依赖于维度的全新数据无关界。

sentences.en: Our techniques involve a dense multiplicative weights update method developed from a regularized dual viewpoint, which we analyze in a way that exploits structure specific to positive LPs.
sentences.zh: 我们的技术涉及一种从正则化对偶视角发展而来的稠密乘法权重更新方法，我们以利用正线性规划特有结构的方式对其进行分析。

title_en: Solving Spatial-Spectral Fusion with Latent Spectral Operators
title_zh: 利用潜在光谱算子求解空间-光谱融合

sentences.en: Existing deep spatial–spectral fusion (SSF) methods typically learn the fusion mapping in the coordinate domain using convolutions and attentions, making it hard to scale across varying spatial resolutions and offering limited control over the frequency content of the reconstructions, which may further lead to severe spectral distortion.
sentences.zh: 现有的深度空间-光谱融合（SSF）方法通常使用卷积和注意力在坐标域中学习融合映射，这使得它们难以在不同空间分辨率之间扩展，对重建的频率内容控制也有限，还可能进一步导致严重的光谱失真。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose Latent Spectral Operators (LSO), a SSF framework that learns fusion mappings between spectral functions through a structured operator parameterization.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出潜在光谱算子（LSO），这是一个 SSF 框架，通过结构化的算子参数化来学习光谱函数之间的融合映射。

sentences.en: Specifically, LSO first applies a cross-attention projection, where learned latent tokens serve as spectral prompts, to compress high-dimensional observations into a compact latent representation, and then adopts a hierarchical, patch-based architecture to integrate rich multi-scale cues.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，LSO 首先应用交叉注意力投影（其中学习到的潜在 token 充当光谱提示），将高维观测压缩为紧凑的潜在表示；随后采用分层、基于块的架构来整合丰富的多尺度线索。

sentences.en: Furthermore, to parameterize the latent fusion operator in a controllable manner, a Trigonometric Basis Solver is elaborated, which represents the mapping using a trigonometric basis expansion.
sentences.zh: 此外，为了以可控方式参数化潜在融合算子，我们设计了一个三角基求解器，它使用三角基展开来表示所学的映射。

sentences.en: This formulation naturally supports multi-frequency modeling, with a capacity-stability trade-off governed by the number of basis functions.
sentences.zh: 这一公式自然支持多频率建模，其容量与稳定性之间的权衡由基函数数量决定。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on the CAVE and Harvard benchmarks demonstrate that LSO achieves consistent state-of-the-art performance and exhibits strong transferability across different spatial scales.
sentences.zh: 在 CAVE 和 Harvard 基准上的大量实验表明，LSO 取得了一贯的最先进性能，并在不同空间尺度上展现出强大的可迁移性。

title_en: Solving Stochastic Variational Inequalities without the Bounded Variance Assumption
title_zh: 在无有界方差假设下求解随机变分不等式

sentences.en: We analyze algorithms for solving stochastic variational inequalities (VI) without the bounded variance or bounded domain assumptions, where our main focus is min-max optimization with possibly unbounded constraint sets.
sentences.zh: 我们分析在无有界方差或有界域假设下求解随机变分不等式（VI）的算法，其中我们的主要关注点是约束集可能无界的极小极大优化。

sentences.en: We focus on two classes of problems: monotone VIs; and structured nonmonotone VIs that admit a solution to the *weak Minty VI*.
sentences.zh: 我们聚焦于两类问题：单调 VI；以及容许*weak Minty VI* 存在解的结构化非单调 VI。

sentences.en: The latter assumption allows us to solve structured nonconvex-nonconcave min-max problems.
sentences.zh: 后一假设使我们能够求解结构化的非凸-非凹极小极大问题。

sentences.en: For both classes of VIs, to make the expected residual norm less than $\varepsilon$, we show an oracle complexity of $\widetilde{O}(\varepsilon^{-4})$, which is the best-known for constrained VIs.
sentences.zh: 对于这两类 VI，为使期望残差范数小于 $\varepsilon$，我们给出了 $\widetilde{O}(\varepsilon^{-4})$ 的预言机复杂度，这是有约束 VI 中已知最好的结果。

sentences.en: In our setting, this complexity had been obtained with the bounded variance assumption in the literature, which is not even satisfied for bilinear min-max problems with an unbounded domain.
sentences.zh: 在我们的设定中，文献里此前是在有界方差假设下获得这一复杂度的，而该假设对于定义域无界的双线性极小极大问题甚至都不成立。

sentences.en: We obtain this complexity for stochastic oracles whose variance can grow as fast as the squared norm of the optimization variable.
sentences.zh: 我们在随机预言机下方获得了这一复杂度，这些预言机的方差可以随优化变量范数的平方以同样的速度增长。

title_en: Solving the Offline and Online Min-Max Problem of Non-smooth Submodular-Concave Functions: A Zeroth-Order Approach
title_zh: 求解非光滑子模-凹函数的离线与在线极小极大问题：一种零阶方法

sentences.en: We consider max-min and min-max problems with objective functions that are possibly non-smooth, submodular with respect to the minimiser and concave with respect to the maximiser.
sentences.zh: 我们考虑目标函数可能非光滑、关于最小化变量为子模、关于最大化变量为凹的极大极小与极小极大问题。

sentences.en: We investigate the performance of a zeroth-order method applied to this problem.
sentences.zh: 我们考察应用于该问题的零阶方法的性能。

sentences.en: The method is based on the subgradient of the Lovász extension of the objective function with respect to the minimiser and based on Gaussian smoothing to estimate the smoothed function gradient with respect to the maximiser.
sentences.zh: 该方法基于目标函数关于最小化变量的 Lovász 延拓的次梯度，并基于高斯平滑来估计关于最大化变量的平滑函数梯度。

sentences.en: In expectation sense, we prove the convergence of the algorithm to an $\epsilon$-saddle point in the offline case.
sentences.zh: 在期望意义下，我们证明了在离线情形中算法收敛到 $\epsilon$-鞍点。

sentences.en: Moreover, we show that, in the expectation sense, in the online setting, the algorithm achieves $O(\sqrt{N(1+\bar{P}_N)})$ online duality gap, where $N$ is the number of iterations and $\bar{P}_N$ is the path length of the sequence of optimal decisions.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们表明，在期望意义下，在线设定中算法达到 $O(\sqrt{N(1+\bar{P}_N)})$ 的在线对偶间隙，其中 $N$ 是迭代次数，$\bar{P}_N$ 是最优决策序列的路径长度。

sentences.en: The complexity analysis and hyperparameter selection are presented for all the cases.
sentences.zh: 我们给出了所有情形下的复杂度分析与超参数选择。

sentences.en: The theoretical results are illustrated via numerical examples.
sentences.zh: 理论结果通过数值示例加以说明。

title_en: Solving Time-Dependent Differential Equations with Physical Dynamical Systems
title_zh: 利用物理动力学系统求解含时微分方程

sentences.en: Time-Dependent Differential Equations (TDDEs) model dynamical processes across science and engineering, but time-critical applications require solvers delivering high-fidelity trajectories under stringent latency constraints.
sentences.zh: 含时微分方程（TDDE）对整个科学与工程领域的动力学过程进行建模，但时间关键型应用要求求解器在严格的延迟约束下提供高保真轨迹。

sentences.en: Most existing TDDE solvers are limited by time discretization, forcing a latency-accuracy trade-off where smaller step sizes capture high-fidelity trajectories but incur prohibitive runtime, while larger steps meet real-time budgets at the cost of trajectory distortion.
sentences.zh: 大多数现有 TDDE 求解器受限于时间离散化，从而被迫在延迟与精度之间做出权衡：较小的步长能获得高保真轨迹，但运行时间难以承受；较大的步长能满足实时预算，却以轨迹失真为代价。

sentences.en: Dynamical System Machines (DSMs) offer a promising alternative by computing through continuous-time physical evolution, yet existing DSMs struggle to capture the spatiotemporal complexity of TDDEs.
sentences.zh: 动力学系统机器（DSM）通过连续时间的物理演化进行计算，提供了一种有前景的替代方案，然而现有的 DSM 在刻画 TDDE 的时空复杂性方面仍力不从心。

sentences.en: This work introduces DS-TS, a novel TDDE solver that achieves both high-accuracy and ultra-efficiency, leveraging the continuous-time computation of DSMs.
sentences.zh: 本工作提出 DS-TS，一种新型 TDDE 求解器，它借助 DSM 的连续时间计算，同时实现了高精度与超高效率。

sentences.en: DS-TS integrates three key innovations: (1) Excitatory-Inhibitory Inspired Coupling to better model complex spatial interactions;
sentences.zh: DS-TS 整合了三个关键创新：(1) 受兴奋-抑制启发的耦合，以更好地建模复杂的空间交互；

sentences.en: (2) State-aware Dynamic Non-linearity to enable rich inter-node interactions and state-dependent spatiotemporal correlations; and (3) Hierarchical Temporal Integration to capture long-range temporal dependencies.
sentences.zh: (2) 状态感知的动态非线性，以实现丰富的节点间交互与状态相关的时空关联；以及 (3) 层次化时间整合，以捕获长程时间依赖。

sentences.en: Experiments demonstrate that DS-TS achieves high-fidelity solutions while delivering orders-of-magnitude improvements in speed ($\sim 10^3\times$) and energy efficiency ($\sim 10^5\times$) compared to baseline solvers.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，与基线求解器相比，DS-TS 在获得高保真解的同时，在速度（$\sim 10^3\times$）和能效（$\sim 10^5\times$）上实现了数量级的提升。

title_en: SoMA: A Real-to-Sim Neural Simulator for Robotic Soft-Body Manipulation
title_zh: SoMA：面向机器人软体操纵的实到仿神经仿真器

sentences.en: Simulating deformable objects under rich interactions remains a fundamental challenge for real-to-sim robot manipulation, with dynamics jointly driven by environmental effects and robot actions.
sentences.zh: 在丰富交互下仿真可变形物体，对于实到仿机器人操纵仍是一项根本性挑战，其动力学由环境效应与机器人动作共同驱动。

sentences.en: Existing simulators rely on predefined physics or data-driven dynamics without robot-conditioned control, limiting accuracy, stability, and generalization.
sentences.zh: 现有仿真器依赖预定义的物理或数据驱动的动力学，但缺少以机器人状态为条件的控制，从而限制了精度、稳定性与泛化能力。

sentences.en: This paper presents \textbf{SoMA}, a 3D Gaussian Splat simulator for soft-body manipulation.
sentences.zh: 本文提出 \textbf{SoMA}，一个用于软体操纵的 3D 高斯泼溅（Gaussian Splat）仿真器。

sentences.en: SoMA couples deformable dynamics, environmental forces, and robot joint actions in a unified latent neural space for end-to-end real-to-sim simulation.
sentences.zh: SoMA 在统一的潜在神经空间中将可变形动力学、环境力与机器人关节动作耦合起来，用于端到端的实到仿仿真。

sentences.en: Modeling interactions over learned Gaussian splats enables controllable, stable long-horizon manipulation and generalization beyond observed trajectories without predefined physical models.
sentences.zh: 在学习到的高斯泼溅上建模交互，无需预定义的物理模型，即可实现可控、稳定、长程的操纵以及对观察轨迹之外的泛化。

sentences.en: SoMA improves resimulation accuracy and generalization on real-world robot manipulation by 20\%, enabling stable simulation of complex tasks such as long-horizon cloth folding.
sentences.zh: SoMA 将真实机器人操纵上的重仿真精度与泛化能力提升了 20\%，从而能够稳定仿真长程布料折叠等复杂任务。

sentences.en: **Project Page: city-super.github.io/SoMA**
sentences.zh: **项目主页：city-super.github.io/SoMA**

title_en: Sonar-TS: Search-Then-Verify Natural Language Querying for Time Series Databases
title_zh: Sonar-TS：时序数据库的检索-验证式自然语言查询

sentences.en: Natural Language Querying for Time Series Databases (NLQ4TSDB) aims to assist non-expert users retrieve meaningful events, intervals, and summaries from massive temporal records.
sentences.zh: 时序数据库的自然语言查询（NLQ4TSDB）旨在帮助非专家用户从海量时间记录中检索出有意义的事件、区间与摘要。

sentences.en: However, existing Text-to-SQL methods are not designed for continuous morphological intents such as shapes or anomalies, while time series models struggle to handle ultra-long histories.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的 Text-to-SQL 方法并非为处理诸如形状或异常等连续形态意图而设计，而时序模型又难以应对超长历史。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we propose Sonar-TS, a neuro-symbolic framework that tackles NLQ4TSDB via a "Search-Then-Verify" pipeline.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出 Sonar-TS，一个神经符号框架，通过“检索-验证”流程来解决 NLQ4TSDB。

sentences.en: Analogous to active sonar, it utilizes a feature index to "ping'' candidate windows via SQL, followed by generated Python programs to "lock on'' and verify candidates against raw signals.
sentences.zh: 与主动声呐类似，它利用特征索引通过 SQL “ping”候选窗口，随后借助生成的 Python 程序“锁定”候选并对照原始信号进行验证。

sentences.en: To enable effective evaluation, we introduce NLQTSBench, the first large-scale benchmark designed for NLQ over TSDB-scale histories.
sentences.zh: 为了实现有效的评估，我们提出 NLQTSBench，这是首个面向 TSDB 规模历史的 NLQ 大规模基准。

sentences.en: Our experiments highlight the unique challenges within this domain and demonstrate that Sonar-TS effectively navigates complex temporal queries where traditional methods fail.
sentences.zh: 我们的实验凸显了该领域的独特挑战，并表明 Sonar-TS 能有效处理传统方法难以应对的复杂时序查询。

sentences.en: This work presents the first systematic study of NLQ4TSDB, offering a general framework and evaluation standard to facilitate future research.
sentences.zh: 本工作对 NLQ4TSDB 进行了首次系统性研究，提供了通用框架与评估标准，以促进未来的研究。

title_en: SONAR: Spectral‑Contrastive Audio Residuals for Generalizable Deepfake Detection
title_zh: SONAR：面向可泛化深度伪造检测的光谱对比音频残差

sentences.en: Deepfake audio detectors often fail to generalize to unseen attacks, in part due to \emph{spectral bias}: neural networks prioritize low-frequency structure while under-exploiting subtle high-frequency (HF) artifacts left by generative models.
sentences.zh: 深度伪造音频检测器往往无法泛化到未见过的攻击，部分原因在于\emph{spectral bias}：神经网络优先关注低频结构，却对生成模型留下的细微高频（HF）伪影利用不足。

sentences.en: We introduce \textbf{SONAR} (Spectral-cONtrastive Audio Residuals), a frequency-guided framework that \emph{explicitly enforces representation-level consistency} between semantic content and HF residuals.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 \textbf{SONAR}（Spectral-cONtrastive Audio Residuals，光谱对比音频残差），一个频率引导的框架，它\emph{显式强制}语义内容与 HF 残差之间表示层面的一致性。

sentences.en: Unlike prior frequency-aware or dual-stream detectors that treat HF cues as auxiliary features, SONAR encourages structured interaction between content and noise representations in latent space.
sentences.zh: 与将 HF 线索视为辅助特征的传统频率感知或双流检测器不同，SONAR 鼓励潜空间中内容表示与噪声表示之间的结构化交互。

sentences.en: The model employs a dual-path architecture in which an XLSR encoder captures low-frequency content, while a parallel branch with learnable, value-constrained 1D SRM (Spatial Rich Model) high-pass filters distills HF residuals.
sentences.zh: 该模型采用双路径架构：XLSR 编码器捕获低频内容，而一个带有可学习、取值受限的 1D SRM（Spatial Rich Model，空间富模型）高通滤波器的并行分支则提炼 HF 残差。

sentences.en: The two representations are fused via frequency cross-attention and trained with a \emph{Jensen--Shannon alignment loss} that promotes LF–HF consistency for genuine audio and amplifies inconsistency for deepfakes.
sentences.zh: 这两种表示通过频率交叉注意力进行融合，并使用 \emph{Jensen--Shannon alignment loss} 进行训练，该损失对真实音频促进 LF–HF 的一致性，对深度伪造则放大不一致性。

sentences.en: Evaluated on ASVspoof~2021 and in-the-wild benchmarks, SONAR achieves state-of-the-art performance in a \textbf{single run} setting and converges faster than strong baselines.
sentences.zh: 在 ASVspoof~2021 与野外基准上的评估表明，SONAR 在\textbf{单次运行}设定下取得了最先进的性能，并且比强基线的收敛速度更快。

sentences.en: By mitigating the effects of spectral bias through frequency-guided alignment, SONAR provides a fully data-driven and architecture-agnostic approach to generalizable audio deepfake detection.
sentences.zh: 通过频率引导的对齐来减轻光谱偏差的影响，SONAR 为可泛化的音频深度伪造检测提供了一种完全数据驱动且与架构无关的方法。

title_en: SonicMaster: Towards Controllable All-in-One Music Restoration and Mastering
title_zh: SonicMaster：迈向可控的一体化音乐修复与母带处理

sentences.en: Music recordings often suffer from audio quality issues such as excessive reverberation, distortion, clipping, tonal imbalances, and a narrowed stereo image, especially when created in non-professional settings without specialized equipment or expertise.
sentences.zh: 音乐录音常常存在诸如过度混响、失真、削波、音调失衡和窄化的立体声像等音频质量问题，尤其是在没有专业设备或专业知识的非专业环境下制作的录音。

sentences.en: These problems are typically corrected using separate specialized tools and manual adjustments.
sentences.zh: 这些问题通常使用各自独立的专业工具并辅以手动调整来修正。

sentences.en: In this paper, we introduce SonicMaster, the first unified generative model for music restoration and mastering that addresses a broad spectrum of audio artifacts with text-based control.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出 SonicMaster，这是首个用于音乐修复与母带处理的统一生成模型，通过基于文本的控制来处理各种音频伪影。

sentences.en: SonicMaster is conditioned on natural language instructions to apply targeted enhancements, or can operate in an automatic mode for general restoration.
sentences.zh: SonicMaster 以自然语言指令为条件来应用针对性的增强，也可在自动模式下进行通用修复。

sentences.en: To train this model, we construct the SonicMaster dataset, a large dataset of paired degraded and high-quality tracks by simulating common degradation types with nineteen degradation functions belonging to five enhancements groups: equalization, dynamics, reverb, amplitude, and stereo.
sentences.zh: 为训练该模型，我们构建了 SonicMaster 数据集，这是一个包含成对退化与高质量轨道的庞大数据集，通过用十九个属于五个增强组（均衡、动态、混响、幅度和立体声）的退化函数来模拟常见退化类型而成。

sentences.en: Our approach leverages a flow-matching generative training paradigm to learn an audio transformation that maps degraded inputs to their cleaned, mastered versions guided by text prompts.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法借助流匹配生成训练范式，学习一种音频变换，该变换在文本提示的引导下将退化输入映射为其清洗、母带处理后的版本。

sentences.en: Objective audio quality metrics demonstrate that SonicMaster significantly improves sound quality across all artifact categories.
sentences.zh: 客观音频质量指标表明，SonicMaster 在所有伪影类别上都显著提升了音质。

sentences.en: Furthermore, subjective listening tests confirm that listeners prefer SonicMaster's enhanced outputs over other baselines.
sentences.zh: 此外，主观听感测试证实，相比其他基线，听者更偏爱 SonicMaster 的增强输出。

sentences.en: The model and demo samples are available through https://github.com/AMAAI-Lab/SonicMaster.
sentences.zh: 模型与演示样本可通过 https://github.com/AMAAI-Lab/SonicMaster 获取。
