title_en: Sparser Block-Sparse Attention via Token Permutation
title_zh: 通过 Token 置换实现更稀疏的分块稀疏注意力

sentences.en: Scaling the context length of large language models (LLMs) offers significant benefits but is computationally expensive.
sentences.zh: 扩展大语言模型（LLMs）的上下文长度能带来显著好处，但计算开销很大。

sentences.en: This expense stems primarily from the self-attention mechanism, whose $O(N^2)$ complexity with respect to sequence length presents a major bottleneck for both memory and latency.
sentences.zh: 这一开销主要源于自注意力机制，其对序列长度的 $O(N^2)$ 复杂度在内存和延迟两方面都构成了主要瓶颈。

sentences.en: Fortunately, the attention matrix is often sparse, particularly for long sequences, suggesting an opportunity for optimization.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，注意力矩阵往往是稀疏的，尤其对于长序列而言，这暗示着存在优化的机会。

sentences.en: Block-sparse attention has emerged as a promising solution that partitions sequences into blocks and skips computation for a subset of these blocks.
sentences.zh: 分块稀疏注意力已成为一种有前景的解决方案，它将序列划分为多个块，并跳过其中一部分块的计算。

sentences.en: However, the effectiveness of this method is highly dependent on the underlying attention patterns, which can lead to sub-optimal block-level sparsity.
sentences.zh: 然而，该方法的有效性高度依赖于底层的注意力模式，这可能带来次优的块级稀疏性。

sentences.en: For instance, important key tokens for queries within a single block may be scattered across numerous other blocks, leading to computational redundancy.
sentences.zh: 例如，单个块内查询所对应的重要键 token 可能散布在许多其他块中，从而导致计算冗余。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose Permuted Block-Sparse Attention (**PBS-Attn**), a plug-and-play method that leverages the permutation properties of attention to increase block-level sparsity and enhance the computational efficiency of LLM prefilling.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了置换分块稀疏注意力（**PBS-Attn**），一种即插即用的方法，它利用注意力的置换性质来提高块级稀疏性并增强 LLM 预填充的计算效率。

sentences.en: We conduct comprehensive experiments on challenging long-context datasets, demonstrating that PBS-Attn consistently outperforms existing block-sparse attention methods in model accuracy and closely matches the full attention baseline.
sentences.zh: 我们在具有挑战性的长上下文数据集上进行了全面的实验，结果表明 PBS-Attn 在模型精度上始终优于现有的分块稀疏注意力方法，并非常接近全注意力的基线水平。

sentences.en: Powered by our custom permuted-FlashAttention kernels, PBS-Attn achieves an end-to-end speedup of up to $\mathbf{2.75\times}$ in long-context prefilling, confirming its practical viability.
sentences.zh: 借助我们自定义的置换 FlashAttention 内核，PBS-Attn 在长上下文预填充中实现了最高 $\mathbf{2.75\times}$ 的端到端加速，证实了其实用可行性。

sentences.en: Code available at \url{https://github.com/xinghaow99/pbs-attn}.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 \url{https://github.com/xinghaow99/pbs-attn} 获取。

title_en: Sparser, Faster, Lighter Transformer Language Models
title_zh: 更稀疏、更快、更轻量的 Transformer 语言模型

sentences.en: Scaling autoregressive large language models (LLMs) has driven unprecedented progress but comes with vast computational costs.
sentences.zh: 扩展自回归大语言模型（LLMs）推动了前所未有的进展，但也带来了巨大的计算成本。

sentences.en: In this work, we tackle these costs by leveraging unstructured sparsity within an LLM's feedforward layers, the components accounting for most of the model parameters and execution FLOPs.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们通过利用 LLM 前馈层内的非结构化稀疏性来应对这些成本，这些层占据了模型绝大部分的参数量和执行时的 FLOPs。

sentences.en: To achieve this, we introduce a new sparse packing format and a set of CUDA kernels designed to seamlessly integrate with the optimized execution pipelines of modern GPUs, enabling efficient sparse computation during LLM inference and training.
sentences.zh: 为实现这一点，我们引入了一种新的稀疏打包格式和一组 CUDA 内核，这些内核旨在与现代 GPU 的优化执行流水线无缝集成，从而在 LLM 推理和训练期间实现高效的稀疏计算。

sentences.en: To substantiate our gains, we provide a quantitative study of LLM sparsity, demonstrating that simple L1 regularization can induce over 99% sparsity with negligible impact on downstream performance.
sentences.zh: 为证实我们的收益，我们对 LLM 稀疏性进行了量化研究，证明简单的 L1 正则化就能带来超过 99% 的稀疏度，而对下游性能的影响可以忽略不计。

sentences.en: When paired with our kernels, we show that these sparsity levels translate into substantial throughput, energy efficiency, and memory usage benefits that increase with model scale.
sentences.zh: 当与我们的内核配合使用时，我们表明这些稀疏度水平可转化为显著的吞吐量、能效和内存使用收益，且收益随模型规模的增大而增加。

sentences.en: We will release all code and kernels under an open-source license to promote adoption and accelerate research toward establishing sparsity as a practical axis for improving the efficiency and scalability of modern foundation models.
sentences.zh: 我们将在开源许可下发布所有代码和内核，以促进采用，并加速研究，推动稀疏性成为提高现代基础模型效率与可扩展性的一个实用维度。

title_en: SparseSSM: Efficient Selective Structured State Space Models Can Be Pruned in One-Shot
title_zh: SparseSSM：高效的选择性结构化状态空间模型可一次性剪枝

sentences.en: State-space language models such as Mamba match Transformer quality while permitting linear complexity inference, yet still comprise billions of parameters that hinder deployment.
sentences.zh: 像 Mamba 这样的状态空间语言模型在允许线性复杂度推理的同时达到了与 Transformer 相当的质量，但仍然包含数十亿参数，阻碍了部署。

sentences.en: While existing one-shot pruning methods are effective for generic linear and attention blocks, they are not designed with the overall Mamba architecture in mind and fail to account for the time-shared and discretized state-transition matrix at the heart of the selective state-space module (SSM).
sentences.zh: 虽然现有的一次性剪枝方法对通用的线性和注意力模块有效，但它们并非针对整个 Mamba 架构而设计，并且没有考虑选择性状态空间模块（SSM）核心中时间共享且离散化的状态转移矩阵。

sentences.en: In this paper, we introduce SparseSSM, the first training-free pruning framework that extends the classic optimal brain surgeon (OBS) framework to state space architectures.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们引入了 SparseSSM，这是第一个无需训练的剪枝框架，将经典的最优脑外科手术（OBS）框架扩展到状态空间架构。

sentences.en: Our layer-wise algorithm (i) derives an approximate second-order saliency score that aggregates Hessian-trace information across time steps, (ii) incorporates a component sensitivity analysis to guide feed-forward network (FFN) pruning, which also sheds light on where redundancy resides in mamba architecture, (iii) can be easily extended to semi-structured and structured sparsity, and generalized to other SSM-based architectures.
sentences.zh: 我们的逐层算法（i）推导出一个近似二阶显著性分数，它跨时间步聚合 Hessian 迹信息；（ii）引入组件敏感性分析来指导前馈网络（FFN）剪枝，这也揭示了 Mamba 架构中冗余所在之处；（iii）可以轻松扩展到半结构化和结构化稀疏，并可推广到其他基于 SSM 的架构。

sentences.en: Empirically, we prune 50% of SSM weights without fine-tuning and observe only limited performance degradation, achieving the current state-of-the-art one-shot pruning algorithm for Mamba-based LLMs.
sentences.zh: 在实验上，我们无需微调即可剪除 50% 的 SSM 权重，仅观察到有限的性能下降，成为目前基于 Mamba 的 LLM 上最先进的一次性剪枝算法。

title_en: SPATIA: Multimodal Generation and Prediction of Spatial Cell Phenotypes
title_zh: SPATIA：空间细胞表型的多模态生成与预测

sentences.en: Understanding how cellular morphology, gene expression, and spatial context jointly shape tissue function is a central challenge in biology.
sentences.zh: 理解细胞形态、基因表达和空间背景如何共同塑造组织功能，是生物学中的一个核心挑战。

sentences.en: Image-based spatial transcriptomics technologies now provide high-resolution measurements of cell images and gene expression profiles, but existing methods typically analyze these modalities in isolation or at limited resolution.
sentences.zh: 基于图像的空间转录组学技术现在提供了细胞图像和基因表达谱的高分辨率测量，但现有方法通常孤立地或以有限的分辨率分析这些模态。

sentences.en: We address the problem by introducing SPATIA, a multi-level generative and predictive model that learns unified, spatially aware representations by fusing morphology, gene expression, and spatial context from the cell to the tissue level.
sentences.zh: 我们通过引入 SPATIA 来解决该问题，这是一种多层次的生成与预测模型，通过融合从细胞到组织层面的形态、基因表达和空间背景，学习统一的、具有空间感知能力的表征。

sentences.en: SPATIA also incorporates a spatially conditioned generative framework with confidence-aware OT reweighting and morphology-profile alignment for modeling target-state morphology distributions.
sentences.zh: SPATIA 还纳入了一个空间条件生成框架，其中包含置信度感知的最优传输（OT）重新加权和形态-表达谱对齐，用于建模目标状态的形态分布。

sentences.en: Specifically, we propose a confidence-aware flow matching objective that reweights weak optimal-transport pairs based on uncertainty.
sentences.zh: 具体来说，我们提出了一个置信度感知的流匹配目标函数，它基于不确定性对较弱的最优传输对进行重新加权。

sentences.en: We further apply morphology-profile alignment to encourage biologically meaningful image generation, enabling the modeling of microenvironment-dependent phenotypic transitions.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步应用形态-表达谱对齐来鼓励具有生物学意义的图像生成，从而能够建模依赖微环境的表型转变。

sentences.en: We assembled a multi-scale dataset consisting of 25.9 million cell-gene pairs across 17 tissues.
sentences.zh: 我们构建了一个包含跨 17 种组织、2590 万个细胞-基因对的多尺度数据集。

sentences.en: We benchmark SPATIA against 18 models across 12 tasks, spanning categories such as phenotype generation, annotation, clustering, gene imputation, and cross-modal prediction.
sentences.zh: 我们将 SPATIA 与 18 个模型在 12 个任务上进行了基准评测，任务涵盖表型生成、标注、聚类、基因插补和跨模态预测等类别。

sentences.en: SPATIA achieves improved performance over state-of-the-art models, improving generative fidelity by 8\% and predictive accuracy by up to 3\%.
sentences.zh: SPATIA 取得了优于最先进模型的性能，将生成保真度提高了 8\%，预测精度最高提高 3\%。

title_en: Spatial Conformal Inference through Localized Quantile Regression
title_zh: 通过局部化分位数回归实现空间共形推断

sentences.en: Reliable uncertainty quantification at unobserved spatial locations is a key challenge in spatial statistics, particularly for complex and heterogeneous datasets.
sentences.zh: 在未观测的空间位置进行可靠的不确定性量化，是空间统计中的一个关键挑战，尤其对于复杂且异质的数据集而言。

sentences.en: While traditional methods such as Kriging rely on strong distributional assumptions, conformal prediction (CP) offers a distribution-free alternative.
sentences.zh: 虽然 Kriging 等传统方法依赖较强的分布假设，但共形预测（CP）提供了一种无分布假设的替代方案。

sentences.en: However, although non-i.i.d. CP theory is well established for time-series data, a significant gap remains for spatial data, where the lack of a natural ordering and discrete index complicates theoretical guarantees.
sentences.zh: 然而，尽管非独立同分布（non-i.i.d.）的 CP 理论在时间序列数据上已经相当成熟，但对于空间数据仍存在显著空白，因为缺乏自然的排序和离散的索引使理论保证变得复杂。

sentences.en: Existing CP theory for spatial data often relies on exchangeability.
sentences.zh: 现有的空间数据 CP 理论通常依赖可交换性。

sentences.en: We propose Localized Spatial Conformal Prediction (LSCP), a model-agnostic framework that bridges this gap by coupling local quantile regression with conformal calibration.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了局部化空间共形预测（LSCP），一个与模型无关的框架，通过将局部分位数回归与共形校准相结合来弥合这一空白。

sentences.en: LSCP conditions on spatial neighborhoods to capture local heterogeneity.
sentences.zh: LSCP 以空间邻域为条件，以捕捉局部异质性。

sentences.en: We show that LSCP retains finite-sample marginal coverage under spatial exchangeability and attains asymptotic conditional coverage under stationarity and spatial mixing.
sentences.zh: 我们表明了LSCP 在空间可交换性下保留了有限样本的边缘覆盖率，并在平稳性和空间混合条件下达到渐近的条件覆盖率。

sentences.en: Across synthetic and real datasets, LSCP consistently achieves near-nominal coverage with tighter and more stable prediction intervals than existing methods that fail to capture these spatial dependencies.
sentences.zh: 在合成数据集和真实数据集上，LSCP 始终能达到接近名义水平的覆盖率，且与无法捕捉这些空间依赖性的现有方法相比，其预测区间更紧致、更稳定。

title_en: Spatial Deconfounder: Interference-Aware Deconfounding for Spatial Causal Inference
title_zh: 空间去混淆器：面向空间因果推断的干扰感知去混淆

sentences.en: Causal inference in spatial domains faces two intertwined challenges: (1) unmeasured spatial factors, such as weather, air pollution, or mobility, that confound treatment and outcome, and (2) interference from nearby treatments that violate standard no-interference assumptions.
sentences.zh: 空间领域的因果推断面临两个相互交织的挑战：（1）未测量的空间因素（如天气、空气污染或流动性）会混淆处理与结果；（2）来自邻近处理的干扰违反了标准的无干扰假设。

sentences.en: While existing methods typically address one by assuming away the other, we show they are deeply connected: *interference reveals structure* in the latent confounder.
sentences.zh: 虽然现有方法通常通过假设掉其中一个来处理另一个，但我们表明它们是深层关联的：*干扰揭示了潜在混淆变量中的结构*。

sentences.en: Leveraging this insight, we propose the **Spatial Deconfounder**, a two-stage method that reconstructs a substitute confounder from local treatment vectors using a conditional variational autoencoder (C-VAE) with a spatial prior, then estimates causal effects with a flexible outcome model.
sentences.zh: 利用这一洞见，我们提出了**空间去混淆器**，一种两阶段方法：它使用带空间先验的条件变分自编码器（C-VAE）从局部处理向量中重建替代混淆变量，然后用灵活的结果模型估计因果效应。

sentences.en: We show that this enables nonparametric identification of direct and spillover effects under weak assumptions—without multiple treatment types or a known latent-field model.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，这在较弱的假设下实现了直接效应和外溢效应的非参数可识别性——既不需要多种处理类型，也不需要已知的潜在场模型。

sentences.en: Empirically, we extend SpaCE, a benchmark suite for spatial confounding, to include treatment interference, and show that the Spatial Deconfounder consistently improves effect estimation across real-world environmental health and social science datasets.
sentences.zh: 在实验上，我们将空间混淆基准套件 SpaCE 扩展以纳入处理干扰，并表明空间去混淆器在真实世界的环境健康和社会科学数据集上持续改善了效应估计。

sentences.en: By turning local interference into a multi-cause proxy for latent spatial confounding, our framework advances robust causal inference for spatial data.
sentences.zh: 通过将局部干扰转化为潜在空间混淆的多原因代理，我们的框架推进了空间数据的稳健因果推断。

title_en: Spatial Memory for Out-of-Vision Manipulation in Vision-Language-Action
title_zh: 面向视觉-语言-动作模型中视野外操作的空间记忆

sentences.en: We introduce SOMA, the Spatial Memory framework for Out-of-Vision Manipulation in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了 SOMA，一个面向视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中视野外操作的空间记忆框架。

sentences.en: Most existing VLAs implicitly assume that task-relevant objects are always visible, leading to brittle and reactive behaviors when targets fall outside the camera’s field of view.
sentences.zh: 大多数现有的 VLA 隐式地假设任务相关物体始终可见，这导致当目标落在相机视野之外时，其行为脆弱且被动。

sentences.en: SOMA addresses this limitation by equipping VLAs with a persistent spatial memory constructed from multi-view observations acquired via a movable head camera, enabling reasoning beyond the current visual frustum.
sentences.zh: SOMA 通过为 VLA 配备一种持久空间记忆来解决这一局限，该记忆由可移动头部相机获取的多视图观测构建而成，使其能够在当前视觉视锥之外进行推理。

sentences.en: The framework consists of three components: Spatial Memory Construction, which aggregates angular-wise observations into a unified spatial–semantic representation through scanning;
sentences.zh: 该框架由三个组件构成：空间记忆构建（Spatial Memory Construction），通过扫描将按角度组织的观测聚合为统一的空间-语义表征；

sentences.en: Dynamic Memory Refinement, which maintains global consistency over time; and Contextual Memory Retrieval, which activates instruction-relevant spatial cues during manipulation.
sentences.zh: 动态记忆精化（Dynamic Memory Refinement），随时间保持全局一致性；以及情境记忆检索（Contextual Memory Retrieval），在操作过程中激活与指令相关的空间线索。

sentences.en: We evaluate SOMA on five challenging real-world out-of-vision manipulation tasks, including multi-step and dual-arm scenarios where target objects are initially invisible.
sentences.zh: 我们在五个具有挑战性的真实世界视野外操作任务上评估了 SOMA，包括目标物体最初不可见的多步骤和双臂场景。

sentences.en: Experimental results show that SOMA not only improves task success rates, but also induces qualitatively different manipulation behaviors, with faster target localization, reduced viewpoint search, and near one-shot grasping under partial observability.
sentences.zh: 实验结果表明，SOMA 不仅提高了任务成功率，还引发了性质上不同的操作行为，其目标定位更快、视点搜索更少，并在部分可观测性下实现了接近一次性的抓取。

sentences.en: Additional experiments on RoboCasa GR1 and SimplerEnv further validate the effectiveness of SOMA’s memory design under conventional fully observable settings.
sentences.zh: 在 RoboCasa GR1 和 SimplerEnv 上的补充实验进一步验证了 SOMA 记忆设计在传统完全可观测设置下的有效性。

sentences.en: Code will be released soon.
sentences.zh: 代码将很快发布。

title_en: Spatial Priors via Space Filling Curves for Small and Limited Data Vision Transformers
title_zh: 面向小型和有限数据视觉 Transformer 的基于空间填充曲线的空间先验

sentences.en: Though Vision Transformers (ViTs) have become the dominant backbone in many computer vision tasks, due to permutation equivariance, their attention mechanism lacks explicit spatial inductive biases.
sentences.zh: 尽管视觉 Transformer（ViTs）已成为许多计算机视觉任务中的主导骨干网络，但由于置换等变性，其注意力机制缺乏显式的空间归纳偏置。

sentences.en: This become particularly important in two settings: when model capacity is small or training data is limited.
sentences.zh: 这在两种场景下尤为关键：当模型容量较小或训练数据有限时。

sentences.en: Inspired by the attention masking strategies in Linear Transformers and the scanning patterns of Vision SSMs, we introduce VIOLIN, a lightweight masked attention mechanism that encodes spatial structure within attention via Space Filling Curves (SFCs) with less than 0.0015% extra parameters and negligible computational overhead.
sentences.zh: 受线性 Transformer 中的注意力掩蔽策略和视觉 SSM 的扫描模式启发，我们引入了 VIOLIN，一种轻量级的掩蔽注意力机制，它通过空间填充曲线（SFCs）在注意力中编码空间结构，额外参数不足 0.0015%，且计算开销可忽略不计。

sentences.en: VIOLIN scans the image using multiple SFCs to construct curve-specific decay masks, which are then combined and multiplied with the attention matrix.
sentences.zh: VIOLIN 使用多条 SFC 扫描图像以构建曲线特定的衰减掩码，然后将这些掩码合并并与注意力矩阵相乘。

sentences.en: Across a wide range of evaluations, VIOLIN consistently improves performance.
sentences.zh: 在广泛的评估中，VIOLIN 都持续提升了性能。

sentences.en: In limited data regimes such as fine-tuning on VTAB-1K, it boosts accuracy across all task groups and by up to 8.7% on the tasks where spatial information is essential.
sentences.zh: 在有限数据场景（例如在 VTAB-1K 上进行微调）中，它在所有任务组上都提升了准确率，在空间信息至关重要的任务上最高提升 8.7%。

sentences.en: It can be combined with parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods such as LoRA to further increase the performance.
sentences.zh: 它可以与 LoRA 等参数高效微调方法相结合，以进一步提升性能。

sentences.en: Beyond fine-tuning, VIOLIN improves various small scale ViT architectures (e.g., DeiT, DINO) during pretraining on ImageNet-1K.
sentences.zh: 除微调之外，VIOLIN 还在 ImageNet-1K 预训练期间提升了多种小规模 ViT 架构（例如 DeiT、DINO）的性能。

sentences.en: Additionally, on pixel-level CIFAR-100 training, a task that is highly dependent on location information, VIOLIN increases accuracy by up to 7.2%.
sentences.zh: 此外，在像素级 CIFAR-100 训练（一项高度依赖位置信息的任务）上，VIOLIN 将准确率最高提升了 7.2%。

sentences.en: Overall, VIOLIN provides a computationally efficient yet effective way to inject spatial inductive bias into ViTs, especially benefiting small models and limited data settings.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，VIOLIN 提供了一种计算高效且行之有效的方式，将空间归纳偏置注入 ViTs，尤其有利于小模型和有限数据场景。

title_en: Spatial-Aware Reduction Framework: Towards  Efficient and Faithful  Visual State Space Models
title_zh: 空间感知缩减框架：迈向高效且忠实的视觉状态空间模型

sentences.en: Mamba demonstrates strong efficiency in modeling long visual sequences.
sentences.zh: Mamba 在建模长视觉序列方面展现出强大的效率。

sentences.en: However, when token reduction is applied to structurally enhanced Mamba variants, these models exhibit a severe performance collapse.
sentences.zh: 然而，当对结构增强的 Mamba 变体应用 token 缩减时，这些模型会出现严重的性能崩溃。

sentences.en: We attribute this degradation to the spatially agnostic nature of existing reduction methods, which violate the two-dimensional structural premise required by the selective scanning mechanism.
sentences.zh: 我们将这种性能下降归因于现有缩减方法在空间上不敏感的特性，这些方法违背了选择性扫描机制所需的二维结构前提。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose STORM, a spatial-aware token reduction framework designed to maintain structural integrity throughout the compression process.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了 STORM，一个空间感知的 token 缩减框架，旨在整个压缩过程中保持结构完整性。

sentences.en: STORM reformulates reduction into a structured operation on spatial units, enforcing localized constraints to maintain both grid topology and neighborhood coherence.
sentences.zh: STORM 将缩减重新表述为对空间单元的结构化操作，通过施加局部约束来同时保持网格拓扑和邻域一致性。

sentences.en: As a plug-and-play module, STORM equips existing reduction pipelines with explicit spatial awareness without any training.
sentences.zh: 作为一个即插即用模块，STORM 无需任何训练即可为现有缩减流水线赋予显式的空间感知能力。

sentences.en: Empirical results demonstrate that STORM achieves state-of-the-art pruning accuracy across diverse vision Mamba backbones under training-free settings.
sentences.zh: 实验结果表明，在无需训练的设置下，STORM 在多种视觉 Mamba 骨干网络上取得了最先进的剪枝精度。

sentences.en: Notably, STORM delivers a substantial accuracy recovery on VMamba, outperforming prior methods by up to 63.3\% in top-1 accuracy.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，STORM 在 VMamba 上实现了显著的精度恢复，在 top-1 准确率上比先前方法最高提升 63.3\%。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, STORM incurs only a 1.0\% accuracy drop on PlainMamba, achieving performance comparable to ViT.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，STORM 在 PlainMamba 上仅造成 1.0\% 的准确率下降，达到了与 ViT 相当的性能。

title_en: SpatialJB: How Text Distribution Art Becomes The "Jailbreak Key" for LLM Guardrails
title_zh: SpatialJB：文本分布艺术如何成为 LLM 护栏的“越狱密钥”

sentences.en: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success across diverse tasks, they remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks, which pose significant risks to their secure deployment.
sentences.zh: 尽管大语言模型（LLMs）在众多任务上取得了显著成功，但它们仍然容易受到越狱攻击，这对其安全部署构成了重大风险。

sentences.en: Driven by their inherent token-by-token autoregressive inference, LLMs exhibit semantic representations that lack robustness against spatially structured perturbations, thereby rendering current output-guardrail safety mechanisms penetrable.
sentences.zh: 由于其固有的逐 token 自回归推理机制，LLM 所展现的语义表征对空间结构化扰动缺乏鲁棒性，从而使当前的输出护栏安全机制变得可以被穿透。

sentences.en: Exploiting the Transformer's spatial weakness, we propose SpatialJB to disrupt the model’s output generation process, allowing harmful content to bypass guardrails without detection.
sentences.zh: 利用 Transformer 的空间弱点，我们提出了 SpatialJB 来破坏模型的输出生成过程，使有害内容能够在不被检测的情况下绕过护栏。

sentences.en: Comprehensive experiments on leading LLMs demonstrate that SpatialJB achieves a nearly 100\% ASR and consistently maintains a success rate exceeding 75\% even against advanced output guardrails like the OpenAI Moderation API, outperforming current jailbreak techniques by a significant margin.
sentences.zh: 在主流 LLM 上的全面实验表明，SpatialJB 实现了接近 100\% 的攻击成功率（ASR），并且即使在面对 OpenAI Moderation API 等先进输出护栏时也持续保持超过 75\% 的成功率，大幅超越了当前的越狱技术。

sentences.en: While **SpatialJB** advances LLM safety research by exposing guardrail weaknesses and highlighting spatial semantics, we also propose and evaluate baseline defense strategies to prevent its potential misuse.
sentences.zh: 尽管 **SpatialJB** 通过暴露护栏弱点并强调空间语义推进了 LLM 安全研究，我们也提出并评估了基线防御策略，以防止其被潜在的滥用。

title_en: Spatially-Adaptive Gradient Re-parameterization for 3D Large Kernel Optimization
title_zh: 面向 3D 大卷积核优化的空间自适应梯度重参数化

sentences.en: Large kernel convolutions offer a scalable alternative to vision transformers for high-resolution 3D volumetric analysis, yet naively increasing kernel size often leads to optimization instability.
sentences.zh: 对于高分辨率 3D 体数据分析，大卷积核卷积提供了一种可扩展的视觉 Transformer 替代方案，但天真地增大卷积核尺寸往往会导致优化不稳定。

sentences.en: Motivated by the spatial bias inherent in effective receptive fields (ERFs), we theoretically demonstrate that structurally re-parameterized blocks induce spatially varying learning rates that are crucial for convergence.
sentences.zh: 受有效感受野（ERFs）中国有的空间偏置启发，我们从理论上证明，结构重参数化的模块会引入空间变化的、对收敛至关重要的学习率。

sentences.en: Leveraging this insight, we introduce Rep3D, a framework that employs a lightweight modulation network to generate receptive-biased scaling masks, adaptively re-weighting kernel updates within a plain encoder architecture.
sentences.zh: 利用这一洞见，我们引入了 Rep3D，一个框架，它使用轻量级调制网络来生成偏置感受野的缩放掩码，在普通编码器架构内自适应地重新加权卷积核更新。

sentences.en: This approach unifies spatial inductive bias with optimization-aware learning, avoiding the complexity of multi-branch designs while ensuring robust local-to-global convergence.
sentences.zh: 这种方法将空间归纳偏置与优化感知学习统一起来，既避免了多分支设计的复杂性，又确保了从局部到全局的稳健收敛。

sentences.en: Extensive evaluations on five 3D segmentation benchmarks demonstrate that Rep3D consistently outperforms state-of-the-art transformer and fixed-prior baselines.
sentences.zh: 在五个 3D 分割基准上的广泛评估表明，Rep3D 持续优于最先进的 Transformer 和固定先验基线。

sentences.en: The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/leeh43/Rep3D.
sentences.zh: 源代码可在 https://github.com/leeh43/Rep3D 公开获取。

title_en: Spatially-Regularized Entropy for Discriminative Token Merging in Fine-Grained Re-Identification
title_zh: 用于细粒度重识别中判别性 Token 合并的空间正则化熵

sentences.en: While Vision Transformers (ViTs) offer strong global modeling, their quadratic computational cost limits utility in latency-sensitive applications like person re-identification (ReID).
sentences.zh: 虽然视觉 Transformer（ViTs）提供了强大的全局建模能力，但其二次方的计算成本限制了它们在行人重识别（ReID）等延迟敏感应用中的实用性。

sentences.en: Existing compression strategies, such as token pruning or generic merging, typically rely on coarse-grained criteria tailored for image classification.
sentences.zh: 现有的压缩策略，如 token 剪枝或通用合并，通常依赖为图像分类量身定制的粗粒度准则。

sentences.en: In fine-grained retrieval, these approaches often discard or smooth out subtle but discriminative local details.
sentences.zh: 在细粒度检索中，这些方法往往会丢弃或抹平细微但具有判别性的局部细节。

sentences.en: To resolve this, we propose SRE-Merge, a training-free framework designed for discriminative token compression.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了 SRE-Merge，一个专为判别性 token 压缩设计的无需训练框架。

sentences.en: SRE-Merge injects spatial priors into the merging process through three mechanisms: (i) Spatial-Entropy Saliency Assessment (SES-Assess), which quantifies token importance as Spatial-Entropic Mass (SE-Mass) by coupling spatial structure with local attention entropy;
sentences.zh: SRE-Merge 通过三种机制将空间先验注入合并过程：（i）空间-熵显著性评估（SES-Assess），它通过将空间结构与局部注意力熵耦合，将 token 的重要性量化为空间熵质量（SE-Mass）；

sentences.en: (ii) Hybrid Context-Affinity Matching (HCA-Match), which guides precise pair selection by combining feature similarity with mass-derived context; and (iii) Energy-Preserving Weighted Fusion (EPW-Fuse), which incorporates SE-Mass weighting to counteract feature variance reduction.
sentences.zh: （ii）混合上下文亲和匹配（HCA-Match），它通过结合特征相似性与源自质量信息的上下文来指导精确的配对选择；（iii）保能量加权融合（EPW-Fuse），它纳入 SE-Mass 加权以抵消特征方差的减小。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks show that SRE-Merge reduces GFLOPs of the base ViT model by about 24\% while retaining competitive retrieval accuracy, establishing a superior accuracy-efficiency trade-off.
sentences.zh: 在标准基准上的大量实验表明，SRE-Merge 在保持有竞争力的检索精度的同时，将基础 ViT 模型的 GFLOPs 降低了约 24\%，确立了更优的精度-效率权衡。

title_en: SpatialReward: Bridging the Perception Gap in Online RL for Image Editing via Explicit Spatial Reasoning
title_zh: SpatialReward：通过显式空间推理弥合在线强化学习用于图像编辑时的感知差距

sentences.en: Online Reinforcement Learning (RL) offers a promising avenue for complex image editing but is currently constrained by the scarcity of reliable and fine-grained reward signals.
sentences.zh: 在线强化学习（RL）为复杂图像编辑提供了一条有前景的途径，但目前受限于可靠且细粒度奖励信号的稀缺。

sentences.en: Existing evaluators frequently struggle with a critical perception gap we term "Attention Collapse," where models neglect cross-image comparisons and fail to capture fine-grained details, resulting in inaccurate perception and miscalibrated scores.
sentences.zh: 现有的评估器经常面临我们称之为“注意力坍缩”（Attention Collapse）的关键感知差距，在这种现象中，模型忽视跨图像比较，无法捕捉细粒度细节，从而导致感知不准确和分数校准失误。

sentences.en: To address these limitations, we propose **SpatialReward**, a reward model that enforces precise verification via explicit spatial reasoning.
sentences.zh: 为解决这些局限，我们提出了 **SpatialReward**，一个通过显式空间推理强制进行精确验证的奖励模型。

sentences.en: By anchoring reasoning to predicted edit regions, SpatialReward grounds semantic judgments in pixel-level evidence, significantly enhancing evaluative accuracy.
sentences.zh: 通过将推理锚定到预测的编辑区域，SpatialReward 将语义判断建立在像素级证据之上，显著提升了评估准确度。

sentences.en: Trained on a curated 260k spatial-aware dataset, our model achieves state-of-the-art performance on MMRB2 and EditReward-Bench, and outperforms proprietary evaluators on our proposed **MultiEditReward-Bench**.
sentences.zh: 在我们精心整理的 26 万条空间感知数据集上训练后，我们的模型在 MMRB2 和 EditReward-Bench 上取得了最先进的性能，并在我们提出的 **MultiEditReward-Bench** 上超越了专有评估器。

sentences.en: Furthermore, SpatialReward serves as a robust signal in online RL, boosting OmniGen2 by +0.90 on GEdit-Bench—surpassing the leading discriminative model and doubling the gain of GPT-4.1 (+0.45).
sentences.zh: 此外，SpatialReward 在在线强化学习中充当了稳健的信号，将 OmniGen2 在 GEdit-Bench 上的成绩提升了 +0.90——超越了领先的判别式模型，并使 GPT-4.1（+0.45）的增益翻倍。

sentences.en: These results demonstrate that spatial reasoning is essential for unlocking effective alignment in image editing.
sentences.zh: 这些结果表明，空间推理对于释放图像编辑中有效对齐的能力至关重要。

authors.name: Wei Chen
authors.institution: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

title_en: Spatio-Temporal LLM: Reasoning about Environments and Actions
title_zh: 时空 LLM：关于环境与动作的推理

sentences.en: Despite significant recent progress of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), current MLLMs are challenged by "spatio-temporal" prompts, i.e., prompts that refer to 1) the entirety of an environment encoded in a point cloud that the MLLM should consider; and simultaneously also refer to 2) actions that happened in part of the environment and are encoded in a short ego-centric video clip.
sentences.zh: 尽管多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）近期取得了显著进步，但当前的 MLLM 在面对“时空”提示时仍面临挑战，这些提示既指 1）编码在点云中的、MLLM 应考虑的整个环境；同时也指 2）环境中部分区域发生过的、编码在短第一人称视频片段中的动作。

sentences.en: However, such a holistic spatio-temporal understanding is important for agents operating in the real world.
sentences.zh: 然而，这种整体的时空理解对于在现实世界中运行的智能体十分重要。

sentences.en: To address this challenge, we first develop a framework to collect a large-scale dataset.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一挑战，我们首先开发了一个框架来收集大规模数据集。

sentences.en: Using the collected "Reasoning about Environments and Actions" (REA) dataset, we show that recent MLLMs indeed struggle to correctly answer "spatio-temporal" prompts.
sentences.zh: 利用收集到的“关于环境与动作的推理”（REA）数据集，我们表明近期的 MLLM 确实难以正确回答“时空”提示。

sentences.en: Building on this dataset, we study two spatio-temporal LLM (STLLM) baselines: 1) STLLM-3D, which directly fuses point cloud, video, and text representations as inputs to the LLM; and 2) STLLM-Aligner, which aligns spatial context with video and text before LLM decoding.
sentences.zh: 基于该数据集，我们研究了两种时空 LLM（STLLM）基线：1）STLLM-3D，它直接将点云、视频和文本表征融合作为 LLM 的输入；2）STLLM-Aligner，它在 LLM 解码前将空间上下文与视频和文本对齐。

sentences.en: Both baselines aim to enhance spatial understanding of environments and temporal grounding of egocentric observations.
sentences.zh: 这两种基线都旨在增强对环境的空间理解和对第一人称观测的时间锚定。

sentences.en: On REA, the STLLM baselines outperform existing models, demonstrating the effectiveness of our designs.
sentences.zh: 在 REA 上，STLLM 基线优于现有模型，证明了我们设计的有效性。

authors.name: Haozhen Zheng
authors.institution: Department of Computer Science, University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign

title_en: SpatioLM: Towards General Physical Spatial Intelligence in Vision-Language Models
title_zh: SpatioLM：迈向视觉-语言模型中的通用物理空间智能

sentences.en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) perform well on commonsense reasoning tasks but struggle with visual spatial reasoning.
sentences.zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）在常识推理任务上表现良好，但在视觉空间推理方面存在困难。

sentences.en: Most existing solutions introduce extra 3D priors or external spatial encoders, which increase complexity and degrade the underlying VLMs' general-purpose capabilities after spatial fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 大多数现有方案会引入额外的 3D 先验或外部空间编码器，这增加了复杂性，并在空间微调后削弱了底层 VLM 的通用能力。

sentences.en: To this end, we propose a parameter-efficient \textit{\textbf{Spatio}-vision \textbf{L}anguage \textbf{M}odels (SpatioLM)}, that enhances spatial intelligence without extra 3D priors or third-party spatial encoders.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们提出了一个参数高效的 \textit{\textbf{Spatio}-vision \textbf{L}anguage \textbf{M}odels (SpatioLM)}，它在不引入额外 3D 先验或第三方空间编码器的情况下增强空间智能。

sentences.en: Concretely, we design a plug-and-play and non-invasive spatio-vision module that elicits the spatial knowledge inherent in VLMs.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们设计了一个即插即用、非侵入式的空间-视觉模块，用以激发 VLM 中固有的空间知识。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we innovatively leverage pseudo depth and camera information as supervision to guide the model in learning physically coherent representations.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们创新性地利用伪深度和相机信息作为监督，引导模型学习物理上一致的表征。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments show that SpatioLM achieves significant improvements in diverse tasks, including spatial perception and understanding while maintains the general-purpose capabilities.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，SpatioLM 在包括空间感知与理解在内的多种任务上取得了显著改进，同时保持了通用能力。

sentences.en: Notably, the model achieves an impressive score of 71.6 on the VSI-Bench (the first model to surpass 70).
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，该模型在 VSI-Bench 上取得了令人瞩目的 71.6 分（首个超过 70 分的模型）。

sentences.en: In addition, it attains competitive performance when transferred to embodied manipulation tasks.
sentences.zh: 此外，它在迁移到具身操作任务时也取得了有竞争力的性能。

title_en: Spatiotemporal Imputation with Graph-Informed Flow Matching
title_zh: 基于图信息流匹配的时空插补

sentences.en: Missing data is a common challenge in spatiotemporal systems, arising in applications such as air quality monitoring and urban traffic management.
sentences.zh: 数据缺失是时空系统中的常见挑战，出现在空气质量监测和城市交通管理等应用中。

sentences.en: Traditional machine learning approaches, like recurrent and graph neural networks, rely on iterative propagation, which tends to accumulate errors over time and space.
sentences.zh: 传统的机器学习方法，如循环神经网络和图神经网络，依赖迭代传播，这种传播往往会在时间和空间上累积误差。

sentences.en: Recent diffusion-based methods mitigate error propagation but require iterative sampling and often depend on problem-agnostic Gaussian priors, limiting both efficiency and effectiveness.
sentences.zh: 近期的基于扩散的方法缓解了误差传播，但需要迭代采样，并且通常依赖与问题无关的高斯先验，这限制了效率和有效性。

sentences.en: To address these limitations, we propose **GiFlow**, a *Graph-Informed Flow Matching* framework for spatiotemporal imputation.
sentences.zh: 为解决这些局限，我们提出了 **GiFlow**，一个用于时空插补的*图信息流匹配*框架。

sentences.en: GiFlow replaces the typical Gaussian prior with a graph-informed prior constructed via spatiotemporal filtering of observable signals, which better aligns the source distribution to the target and thereby simplifies the generation trajectory.
sentences.zh: GiFlow 用通过对可观测信号进行时空滤波而构建的图信息先验取代典型的高斯先验，这能更好地将源分布与目标对齐，从而简化生成轨迹。

sentences.en: The flow field is parameterized by a hybrid vector field model that integrates spatial attention, temporal attention, and spatiotemporal propagation, enabling joint modeling of spatial and temporal dependencies.
sentences.zh: 流场由一个混合向量场模型参数化，该模型整合了空间注意力、时间注意力和时空传播，实现了对空间和时间依赖关系的联合建模。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that the proposed GiFlow outperforms the state-of-the-art approaches in spatiotemporal imputation.
sentences.zh: 在合成数据集和真实数据集上的大量实验表明，所提出的 GiFlow 在时空插补中优于最先进的方法。

sentences.en: The code is available at https://github.com/zepengzhang/GiFlow.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/zepengzhang/GiFlow 获取。

authors.name: Jhony H. Giraldo
authors.institution: Télécom Paris, Institut Polytechnique de Paris

title_en: SPEAR: A Unified SSL Framework for Learning Speech and Audio Representations
title_zh: SPEAR：用于学习语音和音频表征的统一自监督学习框架

sentences.en: Self-supervised learning (SSL) has significantly advanced acoustic representation learning.
sentences.zh: 自监督学习（SSL）显著推进了声学表征学习。

sentences.en: However, most existing models are optimised for either speech or audio event understanding, resulting in a persistent gap between these two domains.
sentences.zh: 然而，大多数现有模型针对语音或音频事件理解进行优化，导致了两个领域之间存在持续的差距。

sentences.en: We address this gap with SPEAR (SPEech and Audio Representations), a self-supervised framework that distils complementary knowledge from a speech-focused SSL teacher and a general-audio SSL teacher into a single unified model.
sentences.zh: 我们通过 SPEAR（语音与音频表征）来解决这一差距，这是一个自监督框架，它将专注于语音的 SSL 教师模型和通用音频 SSL 教师模型的互补知识蒸馏到一个统一模型中。

sentences.en: SPEAR applies multi-codebook vector quantisation to continuous teacher representations to produce fine-grained discrete tokens that capture both semantic and acoustic information.
sentences.zh: SPEAR 对连续的教师表征应用多码本向量量化，以产生能同时捕捉语义和声学信息的细粒度离散 token。

sentences.en: To effectively integrate these heterogeneous representations, SPEAR jointly predicts them given a masked input with an asymmetric pre-training loss.
sentences.zh: 为了有效整合这些异构表征，SPEAR 在给定掩蔽输入的情况下，使用不对称的预训练损失联合预测它们。

sentences.en: We further improve robustness in complex sound scenes through a novel token mixing mechanism.
sentences.zh: 我们通过一种新颖的 token 混合机制进一步提升了在复杂声音场景中的鲁棒性。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that SPEAR consistently outperforms existing unified speech and audio models.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，SPEAR 持续优于现有的统一语音和音频模型。

sentences.en: SPEAR establishes a new state-of-the-art on the SUPERB benchmark, surpassing WavLM Large on 12 of 15 tasks, while achieving competitive performance on the HEAR benchmark.
sentences.zh: SPEAR 在 SUPERB 基准上确立了新的最先进水平，在 15 项任务中的 12 项上超越了 WavLM Large，同时在 HEAR 基准上取得了有竞争力的性能。

sentences.en: These results position SPEAR as a versatile foundation for general-purpose speech and audio representation learning.
sentences.zh: 这些结果表明 SPEAR 是面向通用语音与音频表征学习的多功能基础。

sentences.en: The code and pre-trained models will be released.
sentences.zh: 代码和预训练模型将发布。

authors.name: Chao Zhang
authors.institution: Department of Electronic Engineering, Tsinghua University

title_en: SpecExit: Accelerating Large Reasoning Model via Speculative Exit
title_zh: SpecExit：通过投机性退出加速大型推理模型

sentences.en: Despite their strong performance on reasoning tasks, Large reasoning models (LRMs) often suffer from overthinking, producing unnecessarily long outputs and incurring high end-to-end latency, a significant limitation to their real-world deployment.
sentences.zh: 尽管大型推理模型（LRMs）在推理任务上表现出色，但它们常常遭受过度思考的困扰，产生不必要的冗长输出并带来很高的端到端延迟，这是它们实际部署的重大局限。

sentences.en: To address overthinking, early-exit mechanisms have been proposed to terminate reasoning before typical completion, showing that this approach can effectively shorten generation length with minimal impact on accuracy.
sentences.zh: 为应对过度思考，研究者提出了提前退出机制，在通常完成之前终止推理，表明这种方法能在对准确率影响最小的情况下有效缩短生成长度。

sentences.en: However, their reliance on probing mechanisms introduces a detection overhead that limits their end-to-end latency gains and compromises their generalizability across diverse problems.
sentences.zh: 然而，它们对探测机制的依赖引入了检测开销，从而限制了端到端延迟收益，并损害了跨不同问题的泛化能力。

sentences.en: Inspired by the use of hidden states in speculative decoding, we propose **SpecExit**, a novel framework that predicts both future tokens and an early-exit signal directly from a lightweight draft model without probing overhead.
sentences.zh: 受投机解码中使用隐藏状态的启发，我们提出了 **SpecExit**，一个新颖的框架，它直接从一个轻量级草稿模型预测未来的 token 和提前退出信号，且没有探测开销。

sentences.en: Our method offers significant improvements, achieving up to 66\% generation length reduction and 2.5$\times$ end-to-end speedup compared with the speculative decoding baseline, without compromising accuracy.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法带来了显著改进：与投机解码基线相比，生成长度最高减少 66\%，端到端速度提升 2.5$\times$，且不损害准确率。

sentences.en: Our method leverages the inherent signals from hidden states to provide effective early-exit signals, suggesting broader use of hidden states for efficient reasoning.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法利用来自隐藏状态的内在信号提供有效的提前退出信号，这表明隐藏状态可在高效推理中得到更广泛的应用。

sentences.en: Our code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SpecExit-B802.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SpecExit-B802 获取。

authors.name: Runzhi Fan
authors.institution: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China

title_en: SpecForge: A Flexible and Efficient Open-Source Training Framework for Speculative Decoding
title_zh: SpecForge：一个灵活高效的投机解码开源训练框架

sentences.en: Speculative decoding mitigates the memory-bound nature of LLM decoding by using a lightweight draft model to propose multiple tokens for parallel verification.
sentences.zh: 投机解码通过使用轻量级草稿模型提出多个 token 进行并行验证，从而缓解了 LLM 解码受内存限制的特性。

sentences.en: However, its adoption has been limited by the lack of high-quality draft models and scalable training infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 然而，由于缺乏高质量的草稿模型和可扩展的训练基础设施，其采用受到限制。

sentences.en: We introduce SpecForge, an open-source and efficient framework for training speculative decoding models with full support for EAGLE-3.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了 SpecForge，一个用于训练投机解码模型的开源高效框架，并完全支持 EAGLE-3。

sentences.en: SpecForge incorporates target–draft decoupling, hybrid parallelism, optimized training kernels, and tight integration with production-grade inference engines, enabling up to 9.9x faster EAGLE-3 training for Qwen3-235B-A22B compared to the baseline.
sentences.zh: SpecForge 整合了目标–草稿解耦、混合并行、优化的训练内核，以及与生产级推理引擎的紧密集成，使得 Qwen3-235B-A22B 的 EAGLE-3 训练相比基线最高提速 9.9 倍。

sentences.en: We further release SpecBundle, a suite of production-grade EAGLE-3 draft models trained with SpecForge for mainstream open-source LLMs, achieving up to 4.48x end-to-end inference speedup on SGLang and addressing the scarcity of high-quality drafts.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步发布了 SpecBundle，一套针对主流开源 LLM、用 SpecForge 训练的生产级 EAGLE-3 草稿模型，在 SGLang 上实现了最高 4.48 倍的端到端推理加速，并解决了高质量草稿稀缺的问题。

sentences.en: Finally, we distill a systematic study of speculative decoding training into practical and actionable recipes to guide real-world adoption.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们将对投机解码训练的系统研究提炼为实用且可操作的配方，以指导实际应用。

authors.name: Fan Yin
authors.institution: Beijing University of Post and Telecommunications

title_en: SpecMD: A Comprehensive Study On Speculative Expert Prefetching
title_zh: SpecMD：关于投机性专家预取的综合性研究

sentences.en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models enable sparse expert activation, meaning that only a subset of the model’s parameters is used during each inference.
sentences.zh: 混合专家（MoE）模型实现了稀疏的专家激活，这意味着每次推理时只使用模型参数的一个子集。

sentences.en: However, to translate this sparsity into practical performance, an expert caching mechanism is required.
sentences.zh: 然而，要将这种稀疏性转化为实际性能，需要一种专家缓存机制。

sentences.en: Previous works have proposed hardware-centric caching policies, but how these various caching policies interact with each other and different hardware specification remains poorly understood.
sentences.zh: 先前的工作提出了以硬件为中心的缓存策略，但这些不同的缓存策略之间以及它们与不同硬件规格的相互作用，仍然缺乏深入理解。

sentences.en: To address this gap, we develop \textbf{SpecMD}, a standardized framework for benchmarking ad-hoc cache policies on various hardware configurations.
sentences.zh: 为弥补这一空白，我们开发了 \textbf{SpecMD}，一个用于在各种硬件配置上对临时缓存策略进行基准评测的标准化框架。

sentences.en: Using SpecMD, we perform an exhaustive benchmarking of several MoE caching strategies, reproducing and extending prior approaches in controlled settings with realistic constraints.
sentences.zh: 使用 SpecMD，我们对多种 MoE 缓存策略进行了穷尽式基准评测，在具有现实约束的受控设置中复现并扩展了先前的方法。

sentences.en: Our experiments reveal that MoE expert access is not consistent with temporal locality assumptions (e.g LRU, LFU).
sentences.zh: 我们的实验表明，MoE 专家访问并不符合时间局部性假设（如 LRU、LFU）。

sentences.en: Motivated by this observation, we propose \textbf{Least-Stale}, a novel eviction policy that exploits MoE's predictable expert access patterns to reduce collision misses by up to $85\times$ over LRU.
sentences.zh: 受这一观察启发，我们提出了 \textbf{Least-Stale}，一种新颖的逐出策略，它利用 MoE 可预测的专家访问模式，比 LRU 最高减少 $85\times$ 的冲突未命中。

sentences.en: With such gains, we achieve over $88\%$ hit rates with up to $34.7\%$ Time-to-first-token (TTFT) reduction on OLMoE at only $5\%$ or $0.6GB$ of VRAM cache capacity.
sentences.zh: 凭借这些收益，在仅 $5\%$ 或 $0.6GB$ 的显存缓存容量下，我们在 OLMoE 上实现了超过 $88\%$ 的命中率，以及最高 $34.7\%$ 的首 token 时间（TTFT）降低。

title_en: SpecPL: Disentangling Spectral Granularity for Prompt Learning
title_zh: SpecPL：解耦频谱粒度以用于提示学习

sentences.en: Existing prompt learning for VLMs exhibits a modality asymmetry, predominantly optimizing text tokens while still relying on frozen visual encoder as holistic extractor and neglecting the spectral granularity essential for fine-grained discrimination.
sentences.zh: 现有的 VLM 提示学习表现出一种模态不对称性：主要优化文本 token，同时仍依赖冻结的视觉编码器作为整体特征提取器，而忽略了细粒度判别所必需的频谱粒度。

sentences.en: To bridge this, we introduce Disentangling Spectral Granularity for Prompt Learning (SpecPL), which approaches prompt learning from a novel spectral perspective via Counterfactual Granule Supervision.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一差距，我们引入了解耦频谱粒度的提示学习（SpecPL），它通过反事实粒度监督，从一个新颖的频谱视角来处理提示学习。

sentences.en: Specifically, we leverage a frozen VAE to decompose visual signals into semantic low-frequency bands and granular high-frequency details.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们利用一个冻结的 VAE 将视觉信号分解为语义上的低频带和细粒度的高频细节。

sentences.en: A frozen Visual Semantic Bank anchors text representations to universal low-frequency invariants, mitigating overfitting.
sentences.zh: 一个冻结的视觉语义库将文本表征锚定到通用的低频不变量上，从而缓解过拟合。

sentences.en: Crucially, fine-grained discrimination is driven by counterfactual granule training: by permuting high-frequency signals, we compel the model to explicitly distinguish visual granularity from semantic invariance.
sentences.zh: 关键在于，细粒度判别由反事实粒度训练驱动：通过置换高频信号，我们迫使模型显式地区分视觉粒度与语义不变性。

sentences.en: Uniquely, SpecPL serves as a universal plug-and-play booster, revitalizing text-oriented baselines like CoOp and MaPLe via visual-side guidance.
sentences.zh: 独特的是，SpecPL 作为一个通用的即插即用增强器，通过视觉侧引导使 CoOp 和 MaPLe 等面向文本的基线焕发新生。

sentences.en: Experiments on 11 benchmarks demonstrate competitive state-of-the-art performance, achieving a new performance ceiling of 81.51\% harmonic-mean accuracy.
sentences.zh: 在 11 个基准上的实验证明了其具有竞争力的最先进性能，实现了 81.51\% 谐波平均准确率的新性能上限。

sentences.en: These results validate that spectral disentanglement with counterfactual supervision effectively bridges the gap in the stability-generalization trade-off.
sentences.zh: 这些结果验证了带有反事实监督的频谱解耦能有效弥合稳定性-泛化权衡中的差距。

title_en: SpecPrune-VLA: Accelerating Vision-Language-Action Models via Action-Aware Self-Speculative Pruning
title_zh: SpecPrune-VLA：通过动作感知的自投机剪枝加速视觉-语言-动作模型

sentences.en: Pruning is a typical acceleration technique for compute-bound models by removing computation on unimportant values.
sentences.zh: 剪枝是面向计算受限模型的典型加速技术，通过移除对不重要值的计算来实现。

sentences.en: Recently, it has been applied to accelerate Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model inference.
sentences.zh: 近年来，它已被用于加速视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的推理。

sentences.en: However, existing acceleration methods focus on local information from the current action step and ignore the global context, leading to $>$20\% success rate drop and limited speedup in some scenarios.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的加速方法只关注当前动作步骤的局部信息而忽略全局上下文，导致在某些场景下成功率下降 $>$20\% 且加速有限。

sentences.en: In this paper, we point out \textbf{spatial-temporal consistency} in VLA tasks: input images in consecutive steps exhibit high similarity, and propose the key insight that token selection should combine local information with global context of the model.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们指出 VLA 任务中的\textbf{spatial-temporal consistency}：连续步骤的输入图像表现出高度相似性，并提出关键洞见：token 选择应将局部信息与模型的全局上下文结合起来。

sentences.en: Based on this, we propose ***SpecPrune-VLA***, a training-free, two-level pruning method with heuristic control.
sentences.zh: 基于此，我们提出了***SpecPrune-VLA***，一种带启发式控制的、无需训练的两级剪枝方法。

sentences.en: **(1) Action-level static pruning.** We leverage global history and local attention to statically reduce visual tokens per action.
sentences.zh: **(1) 动作级静态剪枝。**我们利用全局历史和局部注意力，静态地减少每个动作的视觉 token。

sentences.en: **(2) Layer-level dynamic pruning.** We prune tokens adaptively per layer based on layer-wise importance.
sentences.zh: **(2) 层级动态剪枝。**我们基于逐层的重要性，在每一层自适应地剪除 token。

sentences.en: **(3) Lightweight action-aware controller:** We classify actions as coarse- or fine-grained by the speed of the end effector and adjust pruning aggressiveness accordingly.
sentences.zh: **(3) 轻量级动作感知控制器：**我们根据末端执行器的速度将动作分为粗粒度或细粒度，并据此调整剪枝的激进程度。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments show that SpecPrune-VLA achieves up to 1.57× speedup in LIBERO simulation and 1.70× on real-world tasks, with negligible success rate degradation.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，SpecPrune-VLA 在 LIBERO 仿真中实现了最高 1.57× 的加速，在真实任务上达到 1.70×，而成功率下降可忽略不计。

title_en: Spectra: Rethinking Optimizers for LLMs Under Spectral Anisotropy
title_zh: Spectra：在频谱各向异性下重新思考 LLM 的优化器

sentences.en: Gradient signals in LLM training are highly anisotropic: recurrent linguistic structure concentrates energy into a small set of dominant spectral directions, while context-specific information resides in a long tail.
sentences.zh: LLM 训练中的梯度信号具有高度各向异性：循环语言结构将能量集中到少数几个主导频谱方向上，而上下文特定信息则分布于长尾之中。

sentences.en: We show that this spike–tail separation persists throughout training, with the spike occupying only about 1.5% of directions yet dominating optimizer statistics.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，这种尖峰–长尾分离在整个训练过程中持续存在，尖峰仅占据约 1.5% 的方向，却主导了优化器的统计数据。

sentences.en: This dominance suppresses tail learning by contracting tail updates through second-moment normalization and tightening the globally stable learning-rate bound.
sentences.zh: 这种主导地位通过二阶矩归一化收缩长尾更新，并收紧全局稳定的学习率边界，从而压制了长尾学习。

sentences.en: Motivated by this analysis, we propose Spectra, a spike-aware optimizer that suppresses the dominant low-rank spike subspace without amplifying the noise-sensitive spectral tail.
sentences.zh: 受这一分析启发，我们提出了 Spectra，一种尖峰感知的优化器，它在不放大对噪声敏感的频谱长尾的前提下，压制占主导地位的低秩尖峰子空间。

sentences.en: Spectra tracks the spike subspace via cached, warm-started power iteration and applies low-rank spectral shaping with negligible overhead and substantially reduced optimizer-state memory.
sentences.zh: Spectra 通过缓存的、热启动的幂迭代来跟踪尖峰子空间，并以可忽略的开销和大幅减少的优化器状态内存应用低秩频谱整形。

sentences.en: Across Qwen3-0.6B trained on 100B tokens and LLaMA3-8B trained on 50B tokens, Spectra achieves the lowest final validation loss, improving average downstream accuracy by 1.41/0.89 and 1.62/0.66 points over AdamW/Muon, respectively.
sentences.zh: 在 100B token 上训练的 Qwen3-0.6B 和在 50B token 上训练的 LLaMA3-8B 上，Spectra 取得了最低的最终验证损失，相比 AdamW/Muon，平均下游准确率分别提升了 1.41/0.89 和 1.62/0.66 分。

sentences.en: For wall-clock convergence, Spectra reaches matched loss targets up to 1.31×, 1.34×, and 1.24× faster than AdamW on Qwen3-0.6B, Qwen3-2B-A0.8B, and Qwen3-8B; its speedup over Muon grows as model scale increases from 0.6B to 8B.
sentences.zh: 在墙钟时间收敛方面，Spectra 在 Qwen3-0.6B、Qwen3-2B-A0.8B 和 Qwen3-8B 上分别比 AdamW 快最多 1.31×、1.34× 和 1.24× 达到相同损失目标；随着模型规模从 0.6B 增至 8B，其相比 Muon 的加速比也在增大。

sentences.en: For computational efficiency, Spectra is 5.1× faster than Muon in optimizer processing time, cuts optimizer-state memory by 49.25%, and achieves the lowest measured end-to-end per-step runtime.
sentences.zh: 在计算效率方面，Spectra 的优化器处理时间比 Muon 快 5.1×，优化器状态内存减少了 49.25%，并实现了测得的端到端每步运行时间最低。

sentences.en: Spectra's Megatron integration is available at https://github.com/kimmichtank/spectra.
sentences.zh: Spectra 的 Megatron 集成可在 https://github.com/kimmichtank/spectra 获取。

title_en: Spectral Bridge Variational Inference: Dynamic LoRA via Bures-Wasserstein Gradient Flows
title_zh: 谱桥变分推断：基于 Bures-Wasserstein 梯度流的动态 LoRA

sentences.en: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) is essential for adapting Large Language Models, yet existing methods struggle to balance capacity with computational efficiency.
sentences.zh: 参数高效微调（PEFT）对适配大语言模型至关重要，但现有方法难以在容量与计算效率之间取得平衡。

sentences.en: Standard approaches enforce rigid low-rank constraints, while dynamic alternatives incur significant memory overheads.
sentences.zh: 标准方法强制执行刚性的低秩约束，而动态替代方案则会产生显著的内存开销。

sentences.en: To resolve this, we propose Spectral Bridge Variational Inference (SBVI), a geometric framework reformulating LoRA as a continuous Wasserstein gradient flow on the manifold of Gaussian measures.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了谱桥变分推断（SBVI），一个将 LoRA 重新表述为高斯测度流形上连续 Wasserstein 梯度流的几何框架。

sentences.en: Instead of fixing ranks at initialization, SBVI governs singular value evolution via a stochastic differential equation driven by thermodynamic competition between task gradients and adaptive entropic friction.
sentences.zh: SBVI 并不在初始化时固定秩，而是通过一个由任务梯度与自适应熵摩擦之间的热力学竞争驱动的随机微分方程来控制奇异值的演化。

sentences.en: This induces a spectral bifurcation that automatically prunes noise modes while amplifying signal-rich components, discovering an optimal layer-wise rank distribution.
sentences.zh: 这会引发谱分岔，它自动剪除噪声模态，同时放大富含信号的成分，从而发现最优的逐层秩分布。

sentences.en: We derive a scalable algorithm with linear complexity using factorized Riemannian retractions and Empirical Bayes friction updates.
sentences.zh: 我们利用分解的黎曼回拉和经验贝叶斯摩擦更新，推导出一个具有线性复杂度的可扩展算法。

sentences.en: Experiments on reasoning and coding benchmarks show SBVI achieves state-of-the-art performance, offering superior accuracy and memory efficiency over existing static and dynamic methods.
sentences.zh: 在推理和编码基准上的实验表明，SBVI 取得了最先进的性能，与现有的静态和动态方法相比，提供了更优的准确率和内存效率。

title_en: Spectral Collapse Drives Loss of Plasticity in Deep Continual Learning
title_zh: 谱坍缩驱动深度持续学习中的可塑性丧失

sentences.en: We investigate why deep neural networks suffer from loss of plasticity in continual learning, and thus fail to learn new tasks without reinitializing parameters.
sentences.zh: 我们研究为什么深度神经网络在持续学习中会遭受可塑性丧失，从而在不对参数重新初始化的情况下无法学习新任务。

sentences.en: We show that this failure is preceded by Hessian spectral collapse at new-task initialization, where meaningful curvature directions vanish and gradient descent becomes ineffective.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，在新任务初始化时，这一失败之前会出现 Hessian 谱坍缩，此时有意义的曲率方向消失，梯度下降变得无效。

sentences.en: Analyzing a linearized ReLU network, we derive explicit $\epsilon$-rank conditions for successful training and prove that the loss-weighted Gram matrix is spectrally equivalent to the Generalized Gauss-Newton approximation, thereby relating NTK dynamics to Hessian curvature.
sentences.zh: 通过分析线性化的 ReLU 网络，我们推导出成功训练的显式 $\epsilon$-秩 条件，并证明损失加权的 Gram 矩阵在谱上与广义 Gauss-Newton 近似等价，从而将 NTK 动力学与 Hessian 曲率联系起来。

sentences.en: Targeting spectral collapse directly, we then discuss the Kronecker factored approximation of the Hessian, which motivates two regularization enhancements: maintaining high effective feature rank and applying L2 penalties.
sentences.zh: 直接针对谱坍缩，我们随后讨论了 Hessian 的 Kronecker 因子分解近似，这引出了两种正则化增强：维持较高的有效特征秩并应用 L2 惩罚。

sentences.en: Experiments on continual supervised and reinforcement learning tasks confirm that combining these two regularizers effectively preserves plasticity.
sentences.zh: 在持续监督学习和强化学习任务上的实验证实，将这两种正则化器相结合能有效保持可塑性。

title_en: Spectral Evolution Search: Efficient Inference-Time Scaling for Reward-Aligned Image Generation
title_zh: 谱演化搜索：面向奖励对齐图像生成的高效推理时扩展

sentences.en: Inference-time scaling offers a flexible way to align visual generative models with downstream objectives without updating model parameters.
sentences.zh: 推理时扩展提供了一种在不更新模型参数的前提下，将视觉生成模型与下游目标对齐的灵活方式。

sentences.en: In modern image generation models, a natural way to do this is to optimize the random noise from which generation starts.
sentences.zh: 在现代图像生成模型中，一种自然的实现方式是优化生成起始时的随机噪声。

sentences.en: However, searching in this high-dimensional noise space is highly inefficient, because many directions have little effect on the final image.
sentences.zh: 然而，在这个高维噪声空间中搜索效率很低，因为许多方向对最终图像几乎没有影响。

sentences.en: We trace this inefficiency to a spectral bias in generative dynamics: model sensitivity to initial perturbations decays rapidly as frequency increases.
sentences.zh: 我们将这种低效归因于生成动力学中的谱偏置：模型对初始扰动的敏感度随频率增大而迅速衰减。

sentences.en: Based on this insight, we propose Spectral Evolution Search (SES), a plug-and-play framework for initial noise optimization that performs gradient-free evolutionary search in a low-frequency subspace.
sentences.zh: 基于这一洞见，我们提出了谱演化搜索（SES），一个用于初始噪声优化的即插即用框架，它在低频子空间中进行无梯度的演化搜索。

sentences.en: Theoretically, we derive the Spectral Scaling Prediction from perturbation propagation dynamics, which explains the frequency-dependent impact of perturbations.
sentences.zh: 在理论上，我们从扰动传播动力学推导出谱缩放预测，它解释了扰动依赖频率的影响。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across diverse settings show that SES substantially improves the trade-off between generation quality and computational cost, consistently outperforming strong baselines under the same compute budget.
sentences.zh: 跨多种设置的大量实验表明，SES 大幅改善了生成质量与计算成本之间的权衡，在相同计算预算下持续优于强基线。

title_en: Spectral Flow Matching: Stabilizing Stochastic GFlowNets via Frequency-Domain Regularization
title_zh: 谱流匹配：通过频域正则化稳定随机 GFlowNets

sentences.en: Generative Flow Networks (GFNs) offer a powerful paradigm for diverse sampling, yet they often exhibit instability and poor convergence when applied to stochastic or sparse-reward environments.
sentences.zh: 生成流网络（GFNs）为多样采样提供了强大的范式，但当应用于随机或奖励稀疏的环境时，它们常常表现出不稳定和收敛性差的问题。

sentences.en: To mitigate the high variance inherent in these settings, we propose a fundamental re-framing of the GFlowNet training objective within the frequency domain.
sentences.zh: 为缓解这些场景中固有的高方差，我们提议在频域内对 GFlowNet 训练目标进行根本性的重新表述。

sentences.en: We present \textbf{Spectral Time-Dependent GFlowNets (ST-GFNs)}, a framework that leverages Fourier analysis to enforce smoothness and stability in learned policies.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 \textbf{Spectral Time-Dependent GFlowNets (ST-GFNs)}，一个利用傅里叶分析在学习到的策略中强制实现平滑性和稳定性的框架。

sentences.en: Our theoretical analysis proves that our proposed spectral loss is mathematically equivalent to regularized value iteration, acting as a principled low-pass filter that separates signal from noise.
sentences.zh: 我们的理论分析证明，我们提出的谱损失在数学上等价于正则化的值迭代，充当一个将信号与噪声分离的有理论依据的低通滤波器。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we tackle the challenge of exploration in sparse landscapes by introducing a novel autocorrelated intrinsic reward derived from the Wiener-Khinchin theorem.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们通过引入一种由维纳-辛钦定理推导出的新颖自相关内在奖励，来应对稀疏景观中的探索挑战。

sentences.en: Through extensive experiments ranging from adversarial games and noisy sequence generation to high-dimensional single-cell perturbation modelling, we demonstrate that ST-GFNs significantly outperform existing baselines in terms of robustness, sample efficiency, and mode discovery.
sentences.zh: 通过从对抗博弈、噪声序列生成到高维单细胞扰动建模的大量实验，我们证明了 ST-GFNs 在鲁棒性、样本效率和模态发现方面显著优于现有基线。

title_en: Spectral Gradient Descent Mitigates Anisotropy-Driven Misalignment: A Case Study in Phase Retrieval
title_zh: 谱梯度下降缓解各向异性驱动的错位：相位恢复中的案例研究

sentences.en: Spectral gradient methods, such as the Muon optimizer, modify gradient updates by preserving directional information while discarding scale, and have shown strong empirical performance in deep learning.
sentences.zh: 谱梯度方法（如 Muon 优化器）通过保留方向信息、丢弃尺度来修改梯度更新，并在深度学习中展现出了强大的实证性能。

sentences.en: We investigate the mechanisms underlying these gains through a dynamical analysis of a nonlinear phase retrieval model with anisotropic Gaussian inputs, equivalent to training a two-layer neural network with quadratic activation and fixed second-layer weights.
sentences.zh: 我们通过对一个具有各向异性高斯输入的非线性相位恢复模型进行动力学分析，来研究这些收益背后的机制；该模型等价于训练一个具有二次激活函数和固定第二层权重的两层神经网络。

sentences.en: Focusing on a spiked covariance setting where the dominant variance direction is orthogonal to the signal, we show that gradient descent (GD) suffers from a variance-induced misalignment: during the early escape phase, high-variance but uninformative directions are multiplicatively amplified, degrading alignment with the true signal under strong anisotropy.
sentences.zh: 在尖峰协方差设置（主导方差方向与信号正交）下，我们表明梯度下降（GD）会遭受方差导致的错位：在早期的逃逸阶段，高方差但无信息的方向被乘性放大，在强各向异性下降低了与真实信号的对齐程度。

sentences.en: In contrast, spectral gradient descent (SpecGD) removes this anisotropic magnification effect, leading to stable alignment and accelerated noise contraction.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，谱梯度下降（SpecGD）消除了这种各向异性的放大效应，从而实现稳定的对齐和加速的噪声收缩。

sentences.en: Numerical experiments confirm the theory and show that these phenomena persist under more general anisotropic covariances.
sentences.zh: 数值实验证实了该理论，并表明这些现象在更一般的各向异性协方差下仍然存在。

authors.name: Masaaki Imaizumi
authors.institution: The University of Tokyo / RIKEN AIP

title_en: Spectral Guidance for Flexible and Efficient Control of Diffusion Models
title_zh: 谱引导：扩散模型的灵活高效控制

sentences.en: We introduce Spectral Guidance, a framework for controlling diffusion models by leveraging the intrinsic geometry of the generative process.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了谱引导（Spectral Guidance），一种通过利用生成过程的内在几何结构来控制扩散模型的框架。

sentences.en: As data is progressively corrupted by noise, only a small number of features remain informative for control.
sentences.zh: 随着数据被噪声逐步破坏，只有少数特征对控制仍具有信息量。

sentences.en: We characterize them as the singular functions of a conditional expectation operator and show that they can be learned via a self-supervised objective.
sentences.zh: 我们将这些特征刻画为条件期望算子的奇异函数，并证明它们可以通过自监督目标学习得到。

sentences.en: Once recovered, this basis enables the projection of arbitrary guidance signals, such as labels, CLIP embeddings, or masks, directly onto the sampling trajectory.
sentences.zh: 一旦恢复出该基，它就能将任意引导信号——如标签、CLIP 嵌入或掩码——直接投影到采样轨迹上。

sentences.en: This approach allows for stable, high-fidelity control without retraining or denoiser backpropagation during sampling.
sentences.zh: 该方法无需重新训练，也无需在采样过程中对去噪器进行反向传播，即可实现稳定、高保真的控制。

sentences.en: Empirically, we improve conditional accuracy on CIFAR-10 by 37 percentage points over the strongest training-free baseline while offering $4\times$ faster sampling.
sentences.zh: 实验上，与最强的免训练基线相比，我们在 CIFAR-10 上的条件准确率提升了 37 个百分点，同时实现了快 $4\times$ 的采样速度。

sentences.en: Moreover, the same representations that support label and CLIP guidance also enable spatial control, such as mask-based guidance, without auxiliary models.
sentences.zh: 此外，支持标签和 CLIP 引导的同一组表示，也无需辅助模型即可实现空间控制，例如基于掩码的引导。

sentences.en: Finally, our framework reveals a phase transition in the generative process, pinpointing the optimal time window for effective guidance.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们的框架揭示了生成过程中的一个相变，并精确定位了进行有效引导的最佳时间窗口。

authors.name: Chenyan Xiong
authors.institution: School of Computer Science, Carnegie Mellon University

title_en: Spectral Heat Flow for Conservative Token Condensation in Vision-Language Models
title_zh: 谱热流：视觉-语言模型中的保守式令牌凝聚

sentences.en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are costly at inference time because they must process long sequences of visual tokens.
sentences.zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）在推理时成本高昂，因为它们必须处理很长的视觉令牌序列。

sentences.en: Existing token pruning methods often degrade under high compression by blindly discarding information, breaking spatial structure or collapsing diversity.
sentences.zh: 现有的令牌剪枝方法在高压缩率下常常出现性能退化，因为它们盲目丢弃信息、破坏空间结构或导致多样性崩溃。

sentences.en: We propose SpecFlow, a training-free framework that shifts the paradigm from destructive pruning to conservative condensation, strictly enforcing spatial coverage and statistical conservation to ensure stability.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 SpecFlow，一个免训练的框架，它将范式从破坏性剪枝转变为保守式凝聚，通过严格保证空间覆盖和统计守恒来确保稳定性。

sentences.en: Treating visual tokens as nodes in a $k$NN graph, SpecFlow (i) computes a stable importance field via spectral heat flow to preserve structural coherence, (ii) allocates budgets via adaptive spatial partitioning to guarantee coverage, and (iii) aggregates discarded information into coreset sinks to maintain statistical conservation.
sentences.zh: 将视觉令牌视为 $k$NN 图中的节点，SpecFlow (i) 通过谱热流计算稳定的重要性场以保持结构一致性，(ii) 通过自适应空间划分来分配预算以保证覆盖，(iii) 将丢弃的信息聚合到核心集汇点以维持统计守恒。

sentences.en: The method is plug-and-play, requires no fine-tuning, and is compatible with FlashAttention.
sentences.zh: 该方法即插即用，无需微调，并且与 FlashAttention 兼容。

sentences.en: Experiments confirm that our SpecFlow outperforms SOTA methods across tasks, VLM architectures, and pruning ratios.
sentences.zh: 实验证实，我们的 SpecFlow 在多个任务、VLM 架构和剪枝比例上均优于 SOTA 方法。

sentences.en: Notably, LLaVA-1.5 with SpecFlow retains 95.6% of original performance despite pruning 88.9% of visual tokens, offering an exceptional efficiency-accuracy balance.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，配备 SpecFlow 的 LLaVA-1.5 尽管剪掉了 88.9% 的视觉令牌，仍保留了 95.6% 的原始性能，在效率与精度之间实现了非凡的平衡。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/Lzy-dot/SpecFlow.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/Lzy-dot/SpecFlow 获取。

title_en: Spectral Imbalance Causes Forgetting in Low-Rank Continual Adaptation
title_zh: 谱不平衡导致低秩持续适应中的遗忘

sentences.en: Parameter-efficient continual learning aims to adapt pre-trained models to sequential tasks without forgetting previously acquired knowledge.
sentences.zh: 参数高效持续学习旨在将预训练模型适配到一系列顺序任务，同时不遗忘先前获得的知识。

sentences.en: Most existing approaches treat continual learning as avoiding interference with past updates, rather than considering what properties make the current task-specific update naturally preserve previously acquired knowledge.
sentences.zh: 大多数现有方法将持续学习视为避免与过去的更新发生干扰，而不是考虑是什么特性使得当前特定于任务的更新能够自然保留先前获得的知识。

sentences.en: From a knowledge-decomposition perspective, we observe that low-rank adaptations exhibit highly imbalanced singular value spectra: a few dominant components absorb most of the adaptation energy, thereby (i) more likely to disrupt previously acquired knowledge and (ii) making the update more vulnerable to interference from subsequent tasks.
sentences.zh: 从知识分解的角度出发，我们观察到低秩适配表现出高度不平衡的奇异值谱：少数主导成分吸收了大部分适配能量，因此 (i) 更容易破坏先前获得的知识，(ii) 使更新更容易受到后续任务干扰的影响。

sentences.en: To enable explicit balance among components, we decouple the *magnitude* of the task update from its *directional structure* and formulate it as a constrained optimization problem on a restricted Stiefel manifold.
sentences.zh: 为了实现各成分之间的显式平衡，我们将任务更新的*magnitude*与其*directional structure*解耦，并将其表述为受限 Stiefel 流形上的约束优化问题。

sentences.en: We address this problem using a projected first-order method compatible with standard deep-learning optimizers used in vision-language models.
sentences.zh: 我们使用一种与视觉-语言模型中所用标准深度学习优化器兼容的投影一阶方法来解决该问题。

sentences.en: Our method mitigates both backward and forward forgetting, consistently outperforming continual learning baselines.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法同时缓解了反向和前向遗忘，始终优于持续学习基线。

sentences.en: Source code is available in supplementary material.
sentences.zh: 源代码可在补充材料中获取。

title_en: Spectral Reach: Understanding Neural Scaling as Progress into the Spectral Tail
title_zh: 谱到达：将神经缩放理解为向谱尾部的进展

sentences.en: Neural scaling laws describe predictable power-law relationships between model size, dataset size, compute, and performance.
sentences.zh: 神经缩放定律描述了模型规模、数据集规模、计算量与性能之间可预测的幂律关系。

sentences.en: While these laws guide the development of modern foundation models, the mechanisms underpinning them remain poorly understood, in part due to the absence of scalable analysis tools.
sentences.zh: 尽管这些定律指导了现代基础模型的发展，但支撑它们的机制仍未被很好地理解，部分原因是缺乏可扩展的分析工具。

sentences.en: To close this gap, we introduce *spectral position*: a scalable measure of which eigenvalues of the empirical neural tangent kernel (eNTK) currently drive loss reduction.
sentences.zh: 为弥补这一空白，我们引入了*spectral position*（谱位置）：一种可扩展的度量，用来衡量经验神经正切核（eNTK）中当前驱动损失降低的是哪些特征值。

sentences.en: Applying this measure to scaling experiments, we find that spectral position decreases throughout training: learning shifts from dominant eigenmodes into the spectral tail.
sentences.zh: 将该度量应用于缩放实验，我们发现谱位置在整个训练过程中持续下降：学习的重点从主导本征模转移到谱尾部。

sentences.en: Larger models reach further into the tail than smaller models, revealing a size-dependent capacity we call *spectral reach*.
sentences.zh: 更大的模型比更小的模型能更深入地触及谱尾部，这揭示了一种与规模相关的能力，我们称之为*spectral reach*（谱到达）。

sentences.en: This suggests why larger models achieve lower losses: they sustain learning on weak spectral signals inaccessible to smaller models.
sentences.zh: 这解释了为什么更大的模型能达到更低的损失：它们能在较小模型无法触及的微弱谱信号上持续推进学习。

sentences.en: We further identify feature learning as a key enabler of spectral reach.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步将特征学习确定为谱到达的关键促成因素。

sentences.en: It adaptively amplifies gradient magnitudes as learning advances, sustaining progress where frozen representations stall.
sentences.zh: 随着学习推进，它会自适应地放大梯度幅度，从而在冻结表示停滞的地方维持进步。

sentences.en: This points to concrete interventions through architecture and optimizer design.
sentences.zh: 这为通过架构和优化器设计进行具体的干预指明了方向。

title_en: Spectral-Informed Neural Networks Outperform Spectral methods in High-dimensional PDEs
title_zh: 谱信息神经网络在高维偏微分方程中优于谱方法

sentences.en: For low-dimensional problems ($d\leq3$), spectral methods can achieve exceptionally high accuracy.
sentences.zh: 对于低维问题（$d\leq3$），谱方法可以实现极高的精度。

sentences.en: For middle-dimensional problems ($4 \leq d \lesssim 10$), spectral methods remain feasible through specific techniques such as sparse grids or hyperbolic cross.
sentences.zh: 对于中维问题（$4 \leq d \lesssim 10$），谱方法通过稀疏网格或双曲交叉等特定技术仍然可行。

sentences.en: However, for high-dimensional problems ($d\gg 10$), spectral methods suffer from the curse of dimensionality.
sentences.zh: 然而，对于高维问题（$d\gg 10$），谱方法会遭遇维数灾难。

sentences.en: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have emerged as a promising approach to overcome this challenge, offering scalability to high dimensions, but often suffer from limited accuracy and efficiency.
sentences.zh: 物理信息神经网络（PINN）已成为克服这一挑战的一种有前景的方法，它能够扩展到高维，但往往精度和效率有限。

sentences.en: Recently proposed spectral-informed neural networks (SINNs) combine spectral methods with PINNs, operating directly in the spectral domain to avoid spatial derivative computations and to reduce memory consumption.
sentences.zh: 近期提出的谱信息神经网络（SINN）将谱方法与 PINN 相结合，直接在谱域中运算，以避免空间导数计算并减少内存消耗。

sentences.en: In this work, we introduce Modified SINNs, which integrate coefficient decay scaling and basis embeddings motivated by harmonic analysis to enhance accuracy in high-dimensional problems and enable accurate approximation of unknown spectral coefficients.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了修正谱信息神经网络（Modified SINNs），它结合了由调和分析启发的系数衰减缩放与基嵌入，以提升高维问题的精度，并能够精确近似未知的谱系数。

sentences.en: Numerical experiments on steady and time-dependent partial differential equations demonstrate that Modified SINNs outperform sparse grid spectral methods on middle-dimensional problems with incomplete spectral information and achieve superior accuracy compared to PINNs on high-dimensional problems.
sentences.zh: 在稳态与时间依赖的偏微分方程上的数值实验表明，对于谱信息不完整的中维问题，Modified SINNs 优于稀疏网格谱方法；在高维问题上，与 PINN 相比，它们也实现了更高的精度。

title_en: Spectral-Progressive Thought Flow for Lightweight Multimodal Reasoning
title_zh: 用于轻量级多模态推理的谱渐进思维流

sentences.en: Multimodal reasoning often relies on long chains of intermediate textual and visual thoughts, where accumulating visual tokens and dense cross-modal attention incur substantial computation and memory overhead.
sentences.zh: 多模态推理通常依赖于中间文本与视觉思维的冗长链条，其中不断累积的视觉令牌和密集的跨模态注意力会带来可观的计算与内存开销。

sentences.en: To address this challenge, we propose Spectral-Progressive Thought Flow (*SpecFlow*), a *novel* lightweight multimodal reasoning framework that represents intermediate visual thoughts in a fixed-size discrete cosine space.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一挑战，我们提出了谱渐进思维流（*SpecFlow*），这是一种*新颖的*轻量级多模态推理框架，在固定大小的离散余弦空间中表示中间视觉思维。

sentences.en: By exploiting strong energy compaction, *SpecFlow* preserves global layout and relational structure while introducing high-frequency details only when increased spatial precision is required.
sentences.zh: 通过利用强能量压缩特性，*SpecFlow* 在保留全局布局与关系结构的同时，仅在需要更高空间精度时才引入高频细节。

sentences.en: To align visual state evolution with linguistic intent, classifier-free guidance enables autoregressive textual thoughts to steer flow-based updates of the visual workspace without expanding the context.
sentences.zh: 为了将视觉状态演化与语言意图对齐，无分类器引导使自回归文本思维能够引导视觉工作区的基于流的更新，而无需扩展上下文。

sentences.en: As a result,*SpecFlow* maintains a bounded visual workspace whose updates depend only on the current visual state and accumulated textual trace, enabling long-horizon inference with stable latency and memory usage independent of reasoning depth.
sentences.zh: 因此，*SpecFlow* 维持一个有界的视觉工作区，其更新仅取决于当前的视觉状态与累积的文本轨迹，从而能够以与推理深度无关的稳定延迟和内存占用进行长程推理。

sentences.en: Empirical results show that *SpecFlow* achieves competitive or superior reasoning performance while reducing computation and memory costs by up to *$2.1\times$*.
sentences.zh: 实验结果表明，*SpecFlow* 在实现具有竞争力甚至更优的推理性能的同时，将计算与内存成本降低了高达 *$2.1\times$*。
